intro.en: Detach comes from French detacher, de- apart plus attacher to fasten, which goes back to Old French tache, a nail or tack.
intro.cn: detach 源自法语 détacher，由 dé-（分开）加 attacher（系住）构成，attacher 可追溯到古法语 tache（钉子、扣件）。

items.en: Tache meant a nail or fastening.
items.cn: 古法语 tache 意为钉子或扣件。

items.en: Attachier meant to fasten with a nail.
items.cn: attachier 意为用钉子固定。

items.en: Detacher meant to unfasten.
items.cn: 法语 détacher 意为解开、拆下。

items.en: Detach entered English for separating things.
items.cn: 十六世纪 detach 以分离义进入英语。

items.en: It gained the military sense of sending off.
items.cn: 十八世纪获得派遣军队的意思。

items.en: Detached now also describes a calm attitude.
items.cn: 如今 detached 也描述冷静超然的态度。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the tach- fasten family; the near-meaning group names other ways of separating.
note.cn: 形近组共享 tach-（固定）家族；近义组是其他表示「分开」的词。

entries.definition: To fasten one thing to another; it shares the tache root but joins instead of separating.

entries.definition: A thing fastened on, or a feeling of affection.

entries.definition: The act of separating, or a calm lack of involvement.

entries.definition: To undo a connection between two things.

entries.definition: To free something from what holds it.

definition_zh: 免疫学；免疫系统（研究或临床语境）；免疫学检验
definition_en: the branch of biology and medicine that studies the immune system, its responses and its disorders
core_image: 实验室里一排抗体检测板，旁边是一张画满细胞相互识别的图
scene: 这里指「免疫学」。 She studied immunology to understand why some patients reject a transplanted organ.
sceneCN: 这里 immunology 指「免疫学」（第 1 个义项：研究免疫系统及其反应的学科）；句意：她学习免疫学，是为了弄明白为什么有些病人会排斥移植器官。图中可辨识物件：显微镜、抗体检测板、免疫细胞示意图、器官移植示意图。

pos.zh: 免疫学；（医院的）免疫学科室；免疫学检验（集合用法）

senses.title: The science of immunity
senses.titleCN: 免疫学：研究免疫系统如何识别与反应的学科
senses.definition: the scientific study of the immune system, including how the body recognises foreign material and responds to it
senses.definitionCN: 研究免疫系统、包括身体如何识别异物并作出反应的学科
senses.example: She studied immunology to understand why some patients reject a transplanted organ.
senses.exampleCN: 她学习免疫学，是为了弄明白为什么有些病人会排斥移植器官。
senses.why: The word is built like any other science: the object of study, immunity, plus -logia, 'the study of'. Immunology began when immunity stopped being a legal idea and became a measurable bodily state.
senses.whyCN: 这个词按科学名词的常规构成：研究对象 immunity 加 -logia「研究」。当免疫从法律概念变成可测量的身体状态，免疫学就诞生了。

senses.title: Clinical specialty
senses.titleCN: 临床免疫学：诊治免疫相关疾病的专科
senses.definition: the medical specialty that diagnoses and treats diseases caused by a faulty or overactive immune system
senses.definitionCN: 诊断与治疗由免疫系统缺陷或过度反应所致疾病的医学专科
senses.example: The immunology clinic follows patients with repeated severe infections.
senses.exampleCN: 免疫科门诊随访那些反复发生严重感染的患者。
senses.why: Once diseases were traced to the immune system itself, a hospital needed a department to manage them, and the name of the science became the name of the service.
senses.whyCN: 当疾病被追到免疫系统本身，医院就需要一个科室来管理它们，学科的名字于是成了服务的名字。

senses.title: The immunology laboratory
senses.titleCN: 免疫学检验：用抗体、细胞等做的实验诊断
senses.definition: in hospital usage, the laboratory service that runs antibody, antigen and cell tests
senses.definitionCN: 医院语境中指运行抗体、抗原与细胞检测的实验室服务
senses.example: Immunology reported that her antibody levels were low.
senses.exampleCN: 免疫学实验室报告她的抗体水平偏低。
senses.why: The tests depend on the same antibody-antigen reactions the science describes, so the ward uses the discipline's name for the bench that performs them.
senses.whyCN: 这些检测依赖的正是该学科所描述的抗原抗体反应，于是病房用学科之名来指执行检测的实验室台。

senses.title: Transplant immunology
senses.titleCN: 移植免疫学：研究排斥与耐受的分支
senses.definition: the branch that studies why a body rejects or accepts transplanted tissue, and how to prevent rejection
senses.definitionCN: 研究身体为何排斥或接受移植组织、以及如何防止排斥的分支
senses.example: Transplant immunology made kidney grafting a routine operation.
senses.exampleCN: 移植免疫学使肾移植成为常规手术。
senses.why: A graft is the clearest test of self versus non-self, so the field grew around surgery and produced both matching tests and anti-rejection drugs.
senses.whyCN: 移植物是「自我与非我」最清楚的试验，因此这一分支围绕外科生长，既产出了配型检验，也产出了抗排斥药物。

senses.title: Tumour immunology
senses.titleCN: 肿瘤免疫学：研究免疫系统与肿瘤的对抗
senses.definition: the branch that studies how the immune system recognises or fails to recognise cancer cells
senses.definitionCN: 研究免疫系统如何识别癌细胞、或为何识别失败的分支
senses.example: Tumour immunology produced drugs that release the brakes on immune cells.
senses.exampleCN: 肿瘤免疫学造出了能解除免疫细胞刹车的药物。
senses.why: Cancer arises from the body's own cells, so the immune system must be taught to see a difference that is almost invisible; this paradox created its own subfield.
senses.whyCN: 癌来自身体自身的细胞，免疫系统必须被教会看见一种几乎看不见的差别；这一悖论催生了独立的分支。

senses.title: Allergy and immunology
senses.titleCN: 变态反应与免疫学：合并设置的专科
senses.definition: the combined specialty that treats allergies, asthma and immune disorders as one clinical field
senses.definitionCN: 把变态反应、哮喘与免疫疾病作为一个临床领域来诊治的合并专科
senses.example: She is board certified in allergy and immunology.
senses.exampleCN: 她获得了变态反应与免疫学的专科认证。
senses.why: Allergy is an immune response aimed at a harmless target, so the two subjects share patients, tests and drugs and are usually taught and practised together.
senses.whyCN: 变态反应是免疫系统对无害目标发起的反应，两者共享病人、检测与药物，因此通常一起教学与执业。

senses.title: Comparative immunology
senses.titleCN: 比较免疫学：跨物种研究防御系统
senses.definition: the branch that compares immune systems across animals and plants to trace how defence evolved
senses.definitionCN: 比较不同动物与植物免疫系统、追溯防御如何演化的分支
senses.example: Comparative immunology shows that insects have their own forms of immune memory.
senses.exampleCN: 比较免疫学显示昆虫有自己形式的免疫记忆。
senses.why: If immunity is a general problem of living things, then comparing species reveals which solutions are ancient and which are recent inventions.
senses.whyCN: 如果免疫是生物普遍面临的问题，那么比较物种就能看出哪些方案古老、哪些是新近的发明。

senses.title: Immunology of infection
senses.titleCN: 感染免疫学：病原与宿主防御的相互作用
senses.definition: the study of how a specific pathogen and the host's immune response act on each other during infection
senses.definitionCN: 研究特定病原与宿主免疫反应在感染过程中如何相互作用
senses.example: The immunology of tuberculosis explains why the disease can stay dormant for years.
senses.exampleCN: 结核病的免疫学解释了这种病为何能潜伏多年。
senses.why: The subject can be attached to a disease, because each germ has evolved its own way of evading or provoking the response, and that interaction needs its own account.
senses.whyCN: 这门学科可以接到具体疾病上，因为每种病原都演化出各自逃避或激起反应的方式，而这种互动需要单独的说明。

intro.en: Immunology joins immunity to the Greek suffix -logia 'the study of'. The word could only appear after immunity had become a biological phenomenon with measurable mechanisms.
intro.cn: immunology 把 immunity 接到希腊后缀 -logia「研究」上。只有当免疫成为具有可测机制的生命现象之后，这个词才可能出现。

items.en: Immunitas first meant exemption from public duties; the medical sense of protection from disease developed only in the late nineteenth century.
items.cn: immunitas 最初指免除公共义务；医学上「免于疾病」的意思要到 19 世纪后期才发展出来。

items.en: Greek logos meant word, account, reason; the suffix -logia named a reasoned account of a subject, and English uses it for every -ology.
items.cn: 希腊 logos 意为言说、论述、理性；后缀 -logia 指对某主题的系统论述，英语用它构成所有 -ology。

items.en: When germ theory identified specific microbes, researchers began to ask why one animal survived an infection and another died, and the question became a science.
items.cn: 当病菌学说识别出具体微生物后，研究者开始追问为何一只动物在感染中存活、另一只死亡，这个问题于是成为一门科学。

items.en: English immunology is recorded from the late nineteenth century, alongside immunologist; the first citations are usually placed in the 1890s.
items.cn: 英语 immunology 记录于 19 世纪后期，与 immunologist 同时出现；通常把最早书证定在 1890 年代。

items.en: As the field grew, immunology divided into clinical, transplant, tumour and comparative branches, and each branch kept the same name with a prefix.
items.cn: 随着领域扩大，免疫学分成临床、移植、肿瘤与比较等分支，每一支都在同一个名字前加一个前缀。

items.en: Source uncertainty: the exact year of the first English use of immunology is not firmly fixed, and the attribution to a single coiner is not established; the 1890s dating is an approximation.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅首见年代存疑）：immunology 英语首见的确切年份无定论，也无法确证由某一人独造；1890 年代之说只是约数。

note.en: The first group holds words built from the same stem or the same -ology pattern; the second holds neighbouring disciplines and the people who practise them.
note.cn: 第一组是用同一词干或同一 -ology 模式造的形近词；第二组是相邻学科与从业者称谓。

entries.definition: A scientist or doctor who practises immunology; -logist marks the person where -logy marks the field.
entries.definitionCN: 从事免疫学的科学家或医生；-logist 指人，-logy 指学科。

entries.definition: Meaning 'relating to immunology or to immune reactions', as in immunological memory.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「免疫学的、免疫反应的」，如免疫记忆。

entries.definition: The bodily or legal state itself; immunology studies it but does not name it.
entries.definitionCN: 指身体或法律上的状态本身；immunology 研究它，但不命名它。

entries.definition: The chemistry of immune reactions; it shares the immuno- prefix but names a method rather than the whole discipline.
entries.definitionCN: 研究免疫反应的化学；共享 immuno- 前缀，但命名的是一种方法而非整门学科。

entries.definition: The study of blood serum and its antibodies; much of what immunology now explains began as serology.
entries.definitionCN: 研究血清及其抗体的学科；免疫学如今解释的许多内容最初属于血清学。

entries.definition: The study of microorganisms; microbiology looks at the invader, immunology at the response.
entries.definitionCN: 研究微生物的学科；微生物学看入侵者，免疫学看反应。

entries.definition: The study of viruses; immunology overlaps with it wherever the host response to a virus is at issue.
entries.definitionCN: 研究病毒的学科；凡是涉及宿主对病毒的反应之处，免疫学与它重叠。

entries.definition: The study of allergies, often practised together with immunology but naming only one kind of immune disorder.
entries.definitionCN: 研究变态反应的学科，常与免疫学合并执业，但只命名一类免疫疾病。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: immuno- 'immunity' + -logy 'the study of' gives 'the study of immunity'.
normal.cn: immuno-「免疫」+ -logy「研究」得出「研究免疫的学科」。

normal.en: The family runs immunology, immunologist, immunological, immunologically, immunopathology.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 immunology、immunologist、immunological、immunologically、immunopathology。

normal.en: Branches are made by adding a prefix: clinical, transplant, tumour, comparative immunology.
normal.cn: 分支靠加前缀构成：临床、移植、肿瘤、比较免疫学。

normal.en: The ward says immunology for the lab that runs antibody tests.
normal.cn: 病房用 immunology 指运行抗体检测的实验室。

normal.en: -logy is the field, -logist the person, -logical the adjective.
normal.cn: -logy 指学科，-logist 指人，-logical 是形容词。

abstract.en: Picture a border guard who must decide, in seconds, whether a face is familiar.
abstract.cn: 想象一名边检员必须在几秒内判断一张面孔是否熟悉。

abstract.en: Picture a lab plate where tiny dots show which antibody has found its match.
abstract.cn: 想象一块实验板，上面的小点显示哪个抗体找到了对手。

abstract.en: Picture two nearly identical cells, one welcomed and one rejected.
abstract.cn: 想象两个几乎一模一样的细胞，一个被接纳，一个被排斥。

examples.en: Modern immunology began with the study of how animals resist infection.
examples.cn: 现代免疫学始于对动物如何抵抗感染的研究。

examples.en: The immunology department runs tests for autoimmune disease.
examples.cn: 免疫科开展自身免疫病的检测。

examples.en: Her lecture traced the split between immunology and serology.
examples.cn: 她的讲座梳理了免疫学与血清学的分家过程。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「immun 免疫 + ology 学科」——研究免疫的学问 → immunology 免疫学

root: 拉丁 immunis「免于劳役的」→ immunity「免疫」+ 希腊 -logia「研究」→ 英语 immunology（19 世纪后期）。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one discipline: the science itself, the hospital specialty, the testing bench, then four branches defined by what they study, and finally the immunology of a single disease.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一门学科展开：学科本身、医院的专科、检验台，随后是四个按研究对象划分的分支，最后是某种具体疾病的免疫学。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bench of antibody tests beside a diagram of cells recognising one another.
core.cn: 核心意象：一排抗体检测板，旁边是细胞相互识别的示意图。

branches.en: THE DISCIPLINE: immunity becomes an object of systematic study.
branches.cn: 学科：免疫成为系统研究的对象。

branches.en: THE HOSPITAL: the same name covers the clinic and the bench that serves it.
branches.cn: 医院：同一个名字既指门诊，也指服务门诊的检验台。

branches.en: SURGERY AND CANCER: two fields where the self/non-self decision is hardest.
branches.cn: 外科与肿瘤：自我与非我判断最艰难的两个领域。

branches.en: ALLERGY: an immune response aimed at a harmless target.
branches.cn: 变态反应：瞄准无害目标的免疫反应。

branches.en: COMPARISON AND INFECTION: the same questions asked across species and across one germ.
branches.cn: 比较与感染：同样的问题，跨越物种来问，也针对单一病原来问。

intro.en: Immunology is immuno- plus -logy, the standard pattern for a science; its relatives swap -logy for -logist, -logical and -pathology.
intro.cn: immunology 是 immuno- 加 -logy，这是科学名词的标准模式；同族词把 -logy 换成 -logist、-logical、-pathology。

latinIntro.en: The first element is Latin immunis; the second is Greek -logia. The word is therefore a Latin-Greek hybrid, like many scientific names.
latinIntro.cn: 第一部分是拉丁 immunis，第二部分是希腊 -logia。因此这个词像许多科学名词一样，是拉丁与希腊的混合体。

items.example: Immunology explains vaccine memory.
items.exampleCN: 免疫学解释了疫苗记忆。

items.example: The immunologist reviewed the biopsy.
items.exampleCN: 免疫学家复核了活检结果。

items.example: The two samples are immunologically identical.
items.exampleCN: 这两个样本在免疫学上是同一的。

items.example: The tissue was immunologically inert.
items.exampleCN: 该组织在免疫学上无活性。

items.meaningCN: 研究免疫所致损伤的学科
items.example: Immunopathology found deposits in the kidney.
items.exampleCN: 免疫病理学在肾脏发现了沉积物。

items.example: Immunogenetics maps the antibody genes.
items.exampleCN: 免疫遗传学绘制抗体基因图谱。

items.meaningCN: 用抗体对组织进行染色
items.example: Immunohistochemistry marked the tumour cells.
items.exampleCN: 免疫组化标记出了肿瘤细胞。

items.example: Immunotherapy extended her remission.
items.exampleCN: 免疫治疗延长了她的缓解期。

definition_zh: 永久的；没完没了的；永生花；永恒
definition_en: lasting for ever, or going on for so long that it seems it will never stop
core_image: 窗台上那束花放了很多年，颜色一点也没退
scene: 老人把一束干花放在窗台上，那是很多年前婚礼上留下来的。 She kept the everlasting flowers in a glass jar beside the window.
sceneCN: 这里 everlasting 是「永生花」（第 3 个义项：经过处理、多年不谢的花）；句意：她把永生花装进玻璃瓶，摆在窗边。

pos.zh: 永久的；没完没了的
永生花；永恒

derivatives.zh: 由 everlasting 加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「永久；永恒」
由动词 last 加 -ing 构成，义为「持久的」，是 everlasting 的后半部分
「持续；延续」，是 lasting 与 everlasting 共同的动词词基

senses.title: Lasting for ever
senses.definition: continuing for all time, with no end
senses.definitionCN: 一直持续下去，没有尽头
senses.example: They promised each other everlasting friendship.
senses.exampleCN: 他们许诺给彼此永远的友谊。
senses.why: Ever means at any time and lasting means continuing, so the compound says continuing at every time.
senses.whyCN: ever 表示「在任何时候」，lasting 表示「持续」，两者相加就是「在任何时候都持续」，所以是永久。

senses.title: Going on far too long
senses.titleCN: 没完没了的；拖得太久的
senses.definition: seeming to continue for too long and becoming annoying
senses.definitionCN: 显得持续太久而让人厌烦
senses.example: The everlasting rain in that town wears everyone down.
senses.exampleCN: 那座镇上没完没了的雨把人磨得疲惫不堪。
senses.why: The same never-ending time is now aimed at things people must sit through, so praise turns into complaint.
senses.whyCN: 同一个「永不结束」的意思被用在人不得不忍受的事情上，褒义就变成了抱怨，于是有了「没完没了」。

senses.title: A preserved flower
senses.definition: a flower that has been treated so that it keeps its shape and colour for years
senses.definitionCN: 经过处理、多年仍保持形状与颜色的花
senses.example: She dried the roses to make everlasting flowers.
senses.exampleCN: 她把玫瑰干燥处理，做成了永生花。
senses.why: A treated flower really does hold its colour for years, so the adjective of endless time is borrowed as the name of the object.
senses.whyCN: 处理过的花确实能多年保住颜色，于是表示「时间无尽」的形容词被直接借来给这种花命名。

senses.title: The endless state itself
senses.definition: endless time or endless existence, used as a noun
senses.definitionCN: 无尽的时间或无尽的存在，作名词使用
senses.example: The poem speaks of the everlasting rather than of this short life.
senses.exampleCN: 这首诗谈的是永恒，而不是这短暂的一生。
senses.why: English turns adjectives into nouns with the definite article, so the everlasting can name the endless state itself.
senses.whyCN: 英语常用定冠词把形容词变成名词，the everlasting 就用来指「永恒」这个状态本身。

intro.en: Everlasting is a native English compound of ever and lasting, and both halves go back to Old English.
intro.cn: everlasting 是英语本族语的复合词，由 ever 与 lasting 组成，两部分都可上溯到古英语。

items.en: Ǣfre means at any time, or always.
items.cn: 古英语 ǣfre 意为「在任何时候、永远」。

items.en: Lǣstan means to follow, to carry out, or to endure.
items.cn: lǣstan 意为跟随、执行，也表示持续。

items.en: Ever and lasting are joined, and the compound is recorded from about the thirteenth century.
items.cn: 中古英语把 ever 与 lasting 拼合，这个复合词约在十三世纪见于记录。

items.en: The word is also used as a noun naming eternity.
items.cn: 十四世纪起，这个词也作名词，指永恒。

items.en: Modern English keeps the adjective of endless time and adds the name of the preserved flower.
items.cn: 现代英语保留「时间无尽」的形容词用法，又添上永生花这个名称。

note.en: Everlasting belongs to the ever family and stands beside the eternal words.
note.cn: everlasting 属于 ever 词族，并与表示「永恒」的一批词相邻。

entries.definition: continuing for a long time
entries.definitionCN: 持久的；长久的

entries.definition: at any time, or always
entries.definitionCN: 在任何时候；永远

entries.definition: for all time to come
entries.definitionCN: 永远；从此以后

entries.definition: lasting for ever, with no beginning and no end
entries.definitionCN: 永恒的；无始无终的

entries.definition: continuing without stopping
entries.definitionCN: 永久的；不间断的

entries.definition: having no end or limit
entries.definitionCN: 无止境的

normalIntro.en: Everlasting is built from two plain English words: ever and lasting.
normalIntro.cn: everlasting 由两个普通英语词拼成：ever 与 lasting。

normal.en: Ever means at all times.
normal.cn: ever 表示「在任何时候」。

normal.en: Lasting means continuing.
normal.cn: lasting 表示「持续」。

normal.en: Everlasting peace is peace that never ends.
normal.cn: everlasting peace 指永不结束的和平。

normal.en: Everlasting fame outlives the person who earned it.
normal.cn: everlasting fame 指人不在之后仍然留下的名声。

normal.en: Compare eternal: eternal is more abstract and formal, while everlasting is plainer.
normal.cn: 对比 eternal：它更抽象、更正式，everlasting 更朴素。

abstract.en: Picture a candle that never burns down.
abstract.cn: 想象一支永远烧不完的蜡烛。

abstract.en: Imagine a song stuck on one line that will not stop.
abstract.cn: 想象一首歌卡在同一句上，怎么也停不下来。

abstract.en: Think of a rose sealed in resin, still red after many years.
abstract.cn: 想象一朵封在树脂里的玫瑰，许多年后仍然鲜红。

examples.en: They promised each other everlasting friendship.
examples.cn: 他们许诺给彼此永远的友谊。

examples.en: The everlasting rain in that town wears everyone down.
examples.cn: 那座镇上没完没了的雨把人磨得疲惫不堪。

examples.en: She dried the roses to make everlasting flowers.
examples.cn: 她把玫瑰干燥处理，做成了永生花。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「爱我 lasting」：说要爱我一直到最后，就成了永久。这只是谐音联想，并不是真正的词源。

root: ever（任何时候）+ lasting（持续的）→ everlasting（永久的）→ 引申为「没完没了」，名词再指永生花；核心义是「时间上没有尽头」。

sensesIntro.en: Everlasting starts as endless time, turns into a complaint about things that drag on, and ends by naming a flower that keeps its colour.
sensesIntro.cn: everlasting 先指没有尽头的时间，再用来抱怨拖得太久的事，最后指一种久不褪色的花。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a flower on the windowsill that never dries out.
core.cn: 核心意象：窗台上一朵永不枯萎的花。

branches.en: Endless time is the core adjective sense.
branches.cn: 时间无尽是核心的形容词义项。

branches.en: The same endlessness becomes a complaint when a thing drags on.
branches.cn: 同一份「无尽」用在拖沓的事情上，就成了抱怨。

branches.en: A preserved flower carries the endlessness into an object name.
branches.cn: 永生花把「无尽」带进了一个实物名称。

branches.en: The noun names the endless state itself.
branches.cn: 名词义项直接指「永恒」这个状态。

branches.en: Both the adjective and the flower name promise that colour and time hold still.
branches.cn: 形容词与花名都许诺颜色与时间停住不动。

intro.en: Everlasting is a transparent English compound: ever plus lasting, with -ness and -ly building further words.
intro.cn: everlasting 是一个透明的英语复合词：ever 加 lasting，再由 -ness 与 -ly 构成新词。

latinIntro.en: Both halves are Germanic rather than Latin, so there are no Latin cognates to list here.
latinIntro.cn: 两个组成部分都属日耳曼语，不来自拉丁语，因此这里没有拉丁同源词可列。

items.example: Ever is the first half of the compound.
items.exampleCN: ever 是复合词的前一半。

items.example: Lasting describes what goes on and on.
items.exampleCN: lasting 描述持续不断的事物。

items.example: The verb last is the base of lasting.
items.exampleCN: 动词 last 是 lasting 的词基。

items.example: Lǣstan is the Old English source of last.
items.exampleCN: lǣstan 是 last 的古英语来源。

items.example: Ǣfre is the Old English source of ever.
items.exampleCN: ǣfre 是 ever 的古英语来源。

items.meaningCN: 把动词变成形容词的词尾
items.example: The suffix -ing turns last into lasting.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ing 把 last 变成 lasting。

items.meaningCN: 把形容词变成名词的词尾
items.example: The suffix -ness forms everlastingness.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ness 构成 everlastingness。

items.meaning: the state of lasting for ever
items.example: Everlastingness is the noun of the adjective.
items.exampleCN: everlastingness 是这个形容词的名词形式。

items.example: The suffix -ly forms everlastingly.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ly 构成 everlastingly。

definition_zh: 文档；文件资料；文档编制；文献记录；证明材料；软件文档；病案记录；法律文件
definition_en: the act of recording something in documents, the body of documents so produced, and the evidence or instructions those documents provide
core_image: 一叠盖章的纸被逐页归档，每页都能证明上一页说过的话
scene: 把镜头拉近到这样一个场景： The clerk stamped each page and filed it, so that the shipment's documentation could be checked at the border.
sceneCN: 这里 documentation 是「随货文件、证明材料」（第 3 个义项：证明文件）；句意：职员给每页盖章并归档，以便这批货物在边境受检时能出示文件。图中可辨识物件：成叠的纸页、印章、档案柜、货箱、边境检查窗口。

pos.zh: 文档；文件资料；文档编制；文献记录；证明材料

forms.label: 单数（文档工作／一套文件）

derivatives.zh: 有文件记录的；有据可查的
无记录的；无合法证件的

senses.title: The body of documents: papers taken as a whole
senses.titleCN: 文件整体：把一批文件当作一个集合
senses.definition: the collected documents that relate to a subject, person, or event
senses.definitionCN: 与某一主题、人物或事件相关的一批文件的总称
senses.example: The archive holds the documentation of the entire expedition.
senses.exampleCN: 档案馆保存着整次探险的全部文件。
senses.why: Latin documentum meant 'lesson, proof, warning', from docere 'to teach'. A set of such papers teaches later readers what happened; -ation gathers the papers into one mass noun.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 documentum 意为“教训、证据、警示”，出自 docere“教”。这样一组纸页向后来的读者“讲述”发生了什么；-ation 把这些纸页聚成一个集合名词。

senses.title: The act of documenting: recording step by step
senses.titleCN: 记录行为：逐步把过程写下来
senses.definition: the process of recording facts, decisions, or procedures in written or digital form
senses.definitionCN: 用书面或数字形式记录事实、决定或流程的过程
senses.example: Careful documentation of each trial made the results reproducible.
senses.exampleCN: 对每次试验的仔细记录使结果可以复现。
senses.why: -ation is an action-noun suffix from Latin -ationem. The word therefore names not only the papers but the deliberate act of producing them, which is why it appears in research methods.
senses.whyCN: -ation 是出自拉丁语 -ationem 的动作名词后缀。因此这个词不只指纸页，也指有意产出纸页的行为，这就是它常出现在研究方法中的原因。

senses.title: Proof papers: what you show an official
senses.titleCN: 证明文件：递给官员查验的那一套
senses.definition: official papers that establish identity, ownership, or compliance
senses.definitionCN: 用来证明身份、所有权或合规性的官方文件
senses.example: Without proper documentation, the goods could not cross the border.
senses.exampleCN: 没有齐全的文件，货物无法过境。
senses.why: This is documentum's 'proof' sense made concrete. A document is evidence because it can be shown; documentation is the bundle you hand over when someone has the right to ask.
senses.whyCN: 这是 documentum“证据”义的落实。文件之所以是证据，是因为它可以被出示；documentation 就是当别人有权查验时你递过去的那一叠。

senses.title: Software documentation: instructions for users and maintainers
senses.titleCN: 软件文档：给用户和维护者的说明
senses.definition: manuals, references, and notes explaining how software is used or built
senses.definitionCN: 说明软件如何使用或如何构建的手册、参考与注记
senses.example: The library is good, but its documentation is out of date.
senses.exampleCN: 这个库不错，但它的文档已经过时。
senses.why: Programming borrowed the word in the mid-20th century. Here documents teach two different readers: users how to operate, maintainers how the code is organised.
senses.whyCN: 编程领域在 20 世纪中期借用了这个词。这里的文档在教两类读者：用户如何操作，维护者如何理解代码结构。

senses.title: Procedure records: written steps that keep work consistent
senses.titleCN: 流程记录：让工作保持一致的书面条文
senses.definition: written descriptions of agreed procedures, used to keep work repeatable and auditable
senses.definitionCN: 对已商定流程的书面描述，用于使工作可重复、可审计
senses.example: The lab's documentation specifies exactly how each sample is stored.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室的流程文件明确规定了每个样本的存放方式。
senses.why: Once the papers are meant to guide future action rather than prove past action, documentation becomes an operating instrument. The same noun now points forward.
senses.whyCN: 一旦这些纸页是用来指导未来行动而非证明过去行动，documentation 就成了操作工具。同一个名词由此指向未来。

senses.title: Historical record: the trace a period leaves behind
senses.titleCN: 历史记录：一个时代留下的痕迹
senses.definition: the surviving written material by which a period or practice is known
senses.definitionCN: 后人据以了解某一时期或某种做法的存世书面材料
senses.example: The documentation of the old guild is fragmentary but revealing.
senses.exampleCN: 这个古老行会的存世记录虽然零碎，却很有揭示力。
senses.why: historians use documentation for what survives rather than what was written deliberately for them. The word shifts from a product of an office to the raw material of a discipline.
senses.whyCN: 历史学家用 documentation 指存留下来的材料，而不是专为他们写的东西。词义从“办公室的产物”转为“一个学科的原料”。

senses.title: Clinical charting: the patient's written trail
senses.titleCN: 病案记录：病人的书面轨迹
senses.definition: the ongoing written record of a patient's condition, treatment, and consent
senses.definitionCN: 对病人病情、治疗与知情同意所作的持续书面记录
senses.example: Poor documentation of the dosage led to a review of the ward.
senses.exampleCN: 剂量记录不完整，导致该病区接受了复查。
senses.why: In medicine the proof sense becomes legal and ethical: if it was not documented, it cannot be defended. The noun carries both the care given and the evidence that it was given.
senses.whyCN: 在医学中，“证据”义带上法律与伦理色彩：没有记录就无法自证。这个名词既承载所给的照护，也承载“确实给过”的证据。

senses.title: Legal paperwork: contracts and filings
senses.titleCN: 法律文件：合同与备案材料
senses.definition: the contracts, deeds, and filings required to make a transaction or status legally valid
senses.definitionCN: 使交易或身份在法律上成立所需的合同、契据与备案材料
senses.example: The merger stalled until the documentation was signed in full.
senses.exampleCN: 直到全部文件签署完毕，合并才得以推进。
senses.why: Here the papers do not merely record the deal; they constitute it. Latin documentum already mixed 'proof' with 'formal instrument', and law keeps both at once.
senses.whyCN: 这里的文件不只是记录交易，而是构成交易。拉丁语 documentum 本就把“证据”与“正式文书”混在一起，法律同时保留了这两层。

intro.en: Documentation is document plus -ation, built in English on the Latin noun documentum. The root verb is docere 'to teach', which also gives doctor, doctrine and docile. The exact date of the English noun is not fixed, so the late-18th-century dating below is approximate.
intro.cn: documentation 是 document 加 -ation，在英语里以拉丁名词 documentum 为基础构成。其根动词是 docere“教”，也给出 doctor、doctrine、docile。英语名词的确切年代没有定论，下面所标 18 世纪后期只是大致估计。

items.en: Software documentation becomes a fixed term, and the word is routinely used for online manuals and API references.
items.cn: 软件文档成为固定术语，这个词开始日常用于在线手册与 API 参考。

items.en: Computing and engineering adopt documentation for written specifications, splitting user documents from maintenance documents.
items.cn: 计算机与工程领域采用 documentation 指书面规范，并把用户文档与维护文档区分开。

items.en: The English noun documentation is recorded in the sense 'the act or result of documenting'; the dating here is approximate.
items.cn: 英语名词 documentation 以“记录的行为或结果”义见于记载；此处年代为大致估计。

items.en: Latin documentum means 'lesson, proof, warning', an instrument that teaches or convinces. The suffix -mentum marks a means or result, so a document is literally 'that by which one is taught'.
items.cn: 拉丁语 documentum 意为“教训、证据、警示”，是一种用来教导或说服的工具。后缀 -mentum 表示手段或结果，因此 document 字面上就是“借以受教之物”。

items.en: docere 'to teach' is generally referred to PIE *dek- 'to take, accept', also seen in Latin decus 'honour' and discere 'to learn'. The reconstruction is standard but indirect.
items.cn: docere“教”一般认为出自原始印欧语 *dek-“接受、接纳”，也见于拉丁语 decus“荣誉”与 discere“学习”。这一重构是通行的，但属于间接推定，*dek- 为重构形式。

note.en: The first group separates true relatives from spelling neighbours; the second compares words that only partially overlap in meaning.
note.cn: 第一组把真正的同族词与只是撞形的词分开；第二组比较只有部分含义重叠的词。

entries.definition: a doctrine accepted without question. It comes from Greek dogma, from dokein 'to seem, think', not from Latin docere 'to teach'.
entries.definitionCN: 不加质疑即接受的教条。它出自希腊语 dogma，源于 dokein“显得、认为”，与拉丁语 docere“教”无关。

entries.definition: a learned person or physician. Latin doctor is 'one who teaches', from docere; the medical sense came later through 'teacher of medicine'.
entries.definitionCN: 博学之人；医生。拉丁语 doctor 就是“教导者”，出自 docere；医学义后来才由“医学的教师”引申而来。

entries.definition: easy to teach or manage. It comes from docilis 'teachable', also from docere, but it names a temperament rather than a record.
entries.definitionCN: 易教、易管教的。它出自 docilis“可教的”，同样源于 docere，但指性情而非记录。

entries.definition: any stored account of facts. It is broader than documentation and may be spoken, visual, or written.
entries.definitionCN: 任何被保存的事实记述。它比 documentation 宽泛，可以是口述的、影像的或书面的。

entries.definition: the routine forms and letters an office must handle. It stresses tedium and bureaucracy, where documentation stresses content and proof.
entries.definitionCN: 办公室必须处理的例行表格与信件。它强调繁琐与官僚气，而 documentation 强调内容与凭证。

entries.definition: material that supports a claim. Documentation can serve as evidence, but evidence may be physical or testimonial.
entries.definitionCN: 支持某一主张的材料。documentation 可以充当证据，但证据也可以是实物或证言。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: documentation is document plus -ation, the same -ation that turns record into an action-noun.
normal.cn: documentation 是 document 加 -ation，正是把动词变成动作名词的那个 -ation。

normal.en: The root docere 'to teach' also gives doctor, doctrine and docile; a document is something that teaches you what happened.
normal.cn: 词根 docere“教”还给出 doctor、doctrine、docile；document 就是教你“发生了什么”的东西。

normal.en: -mentum in documentum is a means-or-result suffix, so a document is 'that by which one is taught or convinced'.
normal.cn: documentum 里的 -mentum 是表示手段或结果的后缀，所以 document 就是“借以受教或被说服之物”。

normal.en: Documentation and dogma look alike but split at the root: docere teaches, dokein merely seems.
normal.cn: documentation 与 dogma 形似却词根不同：docere 是“教”，dokein 只是“显得”。

normal.en: In software, documentation teaches two readers at once: the user who operates and the maintainer who rebuilds.
normal.cn: 在软件里，documentation 同时教两类读者：操作它的用户和维护它的开发者。

abstract.en: Picture a stack of stamped pages: each page is a small teacher standing behind the one before it.
abstract.cn: 想象一叠盖章的纸页：每一页都是站在前一页身后的一个小老师。

abstract.en: The same stack can be proof at a border, a manual on a desk, a chart in a ward, or a deed in a lawyer's file.
abstract.cn: 同一叠纸可以在边境是证明，在桌上是手册，在病房是病案，在律师的卷宗里是契据。

abstract.en: Every sense asks the same question: what does this paper teach the next reader, and who has the right to ask?
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在问同一个问题：这张纸教给下一位读者什么，又是谁有权来查验？

examples.en: The researcher kept meticulous documentation of every measurement.
examples.cn: 研究者对每一次测量都做了细致的记录。

examples.en: Customs officers refused the shipment for lack of documentation.
examples.cn: 海关人员因文件不全而拒绝放行这批货物。

examples.en: Read the documentation before you upgrade the database.
examples.cn: 升级数据库之前请先阅读文档。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「多 Q 门头写生」——多开几道门头，把每笔都写生记下 → documentation 文档、记录

root: 拉丁语 documentum“教训、证据、文书”＝docere“教”＋-mentum（手段／结果后缀）；documentation＝document＋-ation（动作或结果名词后缀）。核心是“把发生的事写下来，使其可教、可证”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: papers that teach a later reader. What changes is the reader and the purpose — an archive, a method, a border officer, a user, a future shift, a historian, a doctor, a court.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：一叠纸在教后来的读者。变化的只是读者与用途——档案馆、研究方法、边境官员、软件用户、下一班同事、历史学家、医生、法庭。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stack of stamped pages, each able to prove what the previous page said.
core.cn: 核心意象：一叠盖章的纸页，每一页都能证明前一页说过的话。

branches.en: PAPERS AND THE ACT: the bundle and the deliberate writing that produced it are two faces of one noun.
branches.cn: 文件与行为：一整叠文件与产出它的有意书写，是同一个名词的两面。

branches.en: PROOF: the pages become evidence at the moment an authority has the right to demand them.
branches.cn: 凭证：当权威有权索取时，纸页就成了证据。

branches.en: INSTRUCTIONS: the same pages turn forward, telling users how to operate and staff how to repeat a procedure.
branches.cn: 说明：同一批纸页转向未来，告诉用户如何操作、员工如何复现流程。

branches.en: THE SURVIVING TRAIL: historians read what remains, clinicians read what was charted, and absence itself becomes information.
branches.cn: 留存的轨迹：历史学家读残存之物，医生读被记录之物，而“缺失”本身也成为信息。

branches.en: CONSTITUTING THE DEAL: in law the papers do not merely record the transaction; they make it valid.
branches.cn: 构成交易：在法律上，文件不只是记录交易，而是使交易生效。

intro.en: Documentation is document plus -ation, from Latin -ationem, an action-or-result suffix. English first borrowed document from Latin documentum, then built the longer noun on it.
intro.cn: documentation 是 document 加 -ation，后者出自拉丁语 -ationem，表示动作或结果。英语先借入 document（来自 documentum），再在它上面造出更长的名词。

latinIntro.en: The root is docere 'to teach', whose stem doc- appears in document, doctor, doctrine and docile. The suffix -mentum in documentum marks means or result.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 docere“教”，其词干 doc- 见于 document、doctor、doctrine、docile。documentum 中的 -mentum 表示手段或结果。

items.meaning: the act of recording, or the body of records produced
items.meaningCN: 记录行为，或由此形成的整套文件（-ation 构成动作／结果名词）
items.example: The documentation of the experiment filled three folders.
items.exampleCN: 这次实验的记录装满了三个文件夹。

items.meaning: a written instrument that records or proves something
items.meaningCN: 记录或证明某事的书面文书（-ment 表示手段／结果）
items.example: Please sign this document in the presence of a witness.
items.exampleCN: 请在见证人在场时签署这份文件。

items.meaning: based on documents, or a film built from recorded material
items.meaningCN: 以文件为据的；纪录片（-ary 构成形容词）
items.example: The evidence was purely documentary.
items.exampleCN: 证据完全是书面的。

items.meaningCN: 有书面记录的；有据可查的
items.example: The species is well documented in regional surveys.
items.exampleCN: 这个物种在区域调查中有充分记录。

items.meaning: lacking records, or lacking official papers
items.meaningCN: 无记录的；无合法证件的
items.example: Undocumented workers are vulnerable to exploitation.
items.exampleCN: 没有合法证件的工人容易遭受剥削。

items.meaning: one who teaches, later a learned or medical practitioner
items.meaningCN: 教导者；后指博士或医生（-tor 表示施动者）
items.example: She became a doctor of philosophy in 1998.
items.exampleCN: 她于 1998 年获得哲学博士学位。

items.meaning: a body of teaching held to be true
items.meaningCN: 被奉为正确的教义、学说
items.example: The party revised its economic doctrine.
items.exampleCN: 该党修订了其经济学说。

items.meaningCN: 可教的；顺从的（-ile 表示“能够被……”）
items.example: The docile horse accepted the new rider.
items.exampleCN: 这匹温顺的马接受了新骑手。

items.meaning: to teach a set of beliefs uncritically
items.meaningCN: 灌输（使人不加批判地接受一套信念）
items.example: The camp sought to indoctrinate its recruits.
items.exampleCN: 该营地试图向新成员灌输思想。

items.meaning: a dramatised film based on real records
items.meaningCN: 纪实剧情片（docu- 来自 document）
items.example: The docudrama blurred records and invention.
items.exampleCN: 这部纪实剧情片把记录与虚构混在一起。

latinEntries.meaning: to teach, to show, to instruct

definition_zh: 光度；发光度；亮度；光辉
definition_en: the total amount of energy a star or other object radiates per second, or the quality of giving off light
core_image: 两枚恒星在夜空里看起来一样亮，其中一枚其实远得多、也亮得多
scene: 两枚恒星在夜空里看起来一样亮，天文学家却要比较它们真正放出多少能量。 Astronomers compare the luminosity of stars to learn how much energy each one pours out.
sceneCN: 这里 luminosity 指「恒星自身每秒辐射的总能量」（第 1 个义项：天体固有的发光本领，与它看起来多亮不同）；句意为天文学家比较恒星的光度，以了解它们各自放出多少能量。可辨识物件：两颗星、夜空、光度曲线、望远镜。

pos.zh: 光度；发光度；亮度；光辉

senses.title: Intrinsic brightness of a star
senses.titleCN: 恒星自身固有的发光本领
senses.definition: the total energy a star radiates each second, independent of how bright it looks from Earth
senses.definitionCN: 恒星每秒辐射的总能量，与它从地球看起来多亮无关
senses.example: Astronomers compare the luminosity of stars to learn how much energy each one pours out.
senses.exampleCN: 天文学家比较恒星的光度，以了解它们各自放出多少能量。
senses.why: Latin luminositas meant fullness of light, and astronomy narrowed it to the power a star actually emits.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 luminositas 意为「充满光」，天文学把它收窄为恒星实际发出的功率。

senses.title: Total radiant power
senses.definition: the rate at which an object emits radiant energy across all wavelengths, measured in watts
senses.definitionCN: 物体在所有波长上发出辐射能量的速率，以瓦特计
senses.example: The luminosity of the sun is about four times ten to the twenty-six watts.
senses.exampleCN: 太阳的光度约为四乘十的二十六次方瓦特。
senses.why: once brightness was given a unit of power, the word became a measurable quantity rather than a look.
senses.whyCN: 一旦亮度有了功率单位，这个词就成了可测量的量，而不只是一种外观。

senses.title: Perceived brightness
senses.titleCN: 人眼所感知的明亮程度
senses.definition: how bright a surface or a light appears to a human observer
senses.definitionCN: 表面或光源在人眼看来有多亮
senses.example: The perceived luminosity of the screen depends on the room lighting.
senses.exampleCN: 屏幕的感知亮度取决于房间的照明。
senses.why: the older sense of shining survives in everyday use, where the observer rather than the physics sets the measure.
senses.whyCN: 「发光」的旧义在日常用法中保留下来，此时衡量者是人眼而非物理量。

senses.title: Brightness of a colour
senses.definition: the lightness of a colour, that is, how much light it appears to reflect
senses.definitionCN: 颜色的明亮程度，即它看起来反射了多少光
senses.example: The luminosity of that yellow makes the whole wall glow.
senses.exampleCN: 那抹黄的明度让整面墙都亮了起来。
senses.why: colour theory borrowed the word for the light-and-dark axis of a hue.
senses.whyCN: 色彩理论借这个词来指色相中「明与暗」的那条轴。

senses.title: Luminosity function
senses.titleCN: 视见函数：人眼对不同波长的敏感度
senses.definition: a standard curve describing how sensitive the average human eye is to each wavelength
senses.definitionCN: 描述普通人眼对各波长敏感程度的标准曲线
senses.example: The luminosity function peaks near green, where the eye is most sensitive.
senses.exampleCN: 视见函数在绿色附近达到峰值，那里人眼最敏感。
senses.why: the word names the function because the curve converts physical power into perceived light.
senses.whyCN: 这个词用来命名该函数，是因为这条曲线把物理功率换算成感知到的光。

senses.title: Luminosity distance
senses.titleCN: 光度距离：由亮度的衰减推算的距离
senses.definition: a cosmological distance inferred from how much a standard candle dims over space
senses.definitionCN: 由标准烛光在空间中变暗多少推算出的宇宙学距离
senses.example: The supernova gave a luminosity distance far beyond the nearby cluster.
senses.exampleCN: 这颗超新星给出的光度距离远在邻近星系团之外。
senses.why: because apparent brightness falls with distance, a measured luminosity becomes a ruler.
senses.whyCN: 由于视亮度随距离衰减，测得的光度就成了尺子。

senses.title: Luminosity in particle physics
senses.titleCN: 粒子物理中的亮度：对撞束的密集程度
senses.definition: a measure of how many particle collisions a collider delivers per unit area per unit time
senses.definitionCN: 衡量对撞机单位面积、单位时间内产生多少次粒子碰撞的量
senses.example: The upgrade doubled the luminosity of the collider.
senses.exampleCN: 这次升级使对撞机的亮度翻倍。
senses.why: the word keeps its core of brightness: a denser beam is a brighter beam in the technical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个词保留「明亮」的核心：更密的束在技术意义上就是一束「更亮」的束。

senses.title: Abstract: brilliance of a person or style
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：人或风格的光彩
senses.definition: a quality of exceptional mental or artistic radiance that draws admiration
senses.definitionCN: 非凡的心智或艺术光彩，引人赞赏
senses.example: The luminosity of her prose comes from plain words used exactly.
senses.exampleCN: 她文笔的光彩来自把朴素的词用得恰到好处。
senses.why: the physical glow becomes a figure for intellectual or artistic light, a very old habit of language.
senses.whyCN: 物理的辉光变成了心智或艺术之光的比喻，这是语言很古老的习惯。

intro.en: Luminosity comes from Late Latin luminositas, fullness of light, from luminosus, full of light, from lumen, light. English took it through French in the sixteenth century.
intro.cn: luminosity 来自晚期拉丁 luminositas「充满光」，其形容词 luminosus「充满光的」，词根 lumen「光」。英语于十六世纪经法语引入。

items.en: Lumen meant light, especially the light of a lamp or of the eye; its genitive is luminis, which is why the family shows lumin-.
items.cn: lumen 意为「光」，尤指灯或眼睛的光；其属格为 luminis，因此词族中出现 lumin- 这一形式。

items.en: Luminosus meant full of light or bright, built with the suffix -osus, which marks abundance.
items.cn: luminosus 意为「充满光的、明亮的」，由表示「充满」的后缀 -osus 构成。

items.en: The abstract noun luminositas named the quality of being full of light, and English borrowed it as luminosity.
items.cn: 抽象名词 luminositas 指「充满光的性质」，英语借入作 luminosity。

items.en: English used luminosity first for the quality of shining, then for the measurable output of a source.
items.cn: 英语最初用 luminosity 指「发光的性质」，后来指光源可测量的输出。

items.en: Modern astronomy fixed luminosity as the intrinsic power of a star, distinct from apparent magnitude.
items.cn: 现代天文学把 luminosity 固定为恒星固有的功率，与视星等区分。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper root only): the pre-Latin origin of lumen is unsettled, and the common link drawn to a Indo-European light root is a reconstruction rather than a proven chain.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅更深词根）：lumen 在拉丁语之前的来源没有定论，把它与某个印欧「光」词根相连属重构，而非已证实的链条。

note.en: Group one holds the light-measuring nouns that are constantly interchanged; group two holds the everyday words for brightness and fame.
note.cn: 第一组是常被互换的光度量名词；第二组是表示明亮与光彩的日常词。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning giving off light, as in luminous paint; it describes, while luminosity measures.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，意为「发光的」，如发光涂料；它作描述，而 luminosity 作计量。

entries.definition: The intensity of light leaving a surface per unit area, a photometric quantity with its own unit.
entries.definitionCN: 单位面积表面射出的光强，是有自身单位的光度量。

entries.definition: Light produced without heat, as by a firefly or a phosphor; it names the process, not the power.
entries.definitionCN: 不伴热产生的光，如萤火虫或荧光粉；它指过程，而非功率。

entries.definition: The amount of light falling on a surface, measured in lux; it is incident rather than emitted.
entries.definitionCN: 落在表面上的光量，以勒克斯计；它是入射光，而非射出光。

entries.definition: How bright something looks or is; it can mean either emitted power or perceived glare.
entries.definitionCN: 某物看起来或实际有多亮；既可指发出的功率，也可指感知到的刺眼程度。

entries.definition: A logarithmic scale of apparent brightness; it is not the same as luminosity, which is intrinsic.
entries.definitionCN: 视亮度的对数标度；与表示固有本领的 luminosity 并不等同。

entries.definition: Bright glowing light, often used with warmth or beauty, as in the radiance of a face.
entries.definitionCN: 明亮的光辉，常带温暖或美的意味，如脸上的光彩。

entries.definition: Power per unit area or per unit solid angle; it is a distribution, while luminosity is a total.
entries.definitionCN: 单位面积或单位立体角的功率；它是分布量，而 luminosity 是总量。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin root, the real astronomy distinction and the real photometric family.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁词根、真实的天文学区分，以及真实的光度量词族。

normal.en: lumen means light and -osity means fullness, so luminosity is fullness of light.
normal.cn: lumen 意为「光」，-osity 意为「充满」，因此 luminosity 就是「充满光」。

normal.en: Astronomy separates luminosity from apparent magnitude: one is intrinsic, the other is seen.
normal.cn: 天文学把光度与视星等分开：前者固有，后者是被看见的。

normal.en: The family runs luminous, luminously, luminance, luminescence.
normal.cn: 词族包括 luminous、luminously、luminance、luminescence。

normal.en: Solar luminosity is a standard unit in astronomy.
normal.cn: 太阳光度是天文学中的标准单位。

normal.en: The plural is luminosities, and the adjective keeps the same root.
normal.cn: 复数是 luminosities，形容词沿用同一词根。

abstract.en: Picture two lamps that look equal from across a field, though one is far larger.
abstract.cn: 想象两盏灯从田野对面看来一样亮，其中一盏其实大得多。

abstract.en: Picture a page whose plain sentences somehow light the room.
abstract.cn: 想象一页文字，句子朴素，却不知怎地把屋子照亮了。

abstract.en: Picture a star that keeps pouring out energy long after no one is watching.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗星在无人注视之后仍不断倾泻能量。

examples.en: The star has a luminosity a thousand times that of the sun.
examples.cn: 这颗恒星的光度是太阳的一千倍。

examples.en: Luminosity distance and redshift together give the expansion rate.
examples.cn: 光度距离与红移合起来给出膨胀速率。

examples.en: The collider reached a luminosity high enough to see rare decays.
examples.cn: 对撞机的亮度高到足以观测稀有衰变。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「lumin（光）+ osity（充满）」——满满地发光 → 光度、发光度

root: 拉丁 lumen（属格 luminis）「光」→ luminosus「充满光的」→ 晚期拉丁 luminositas「充满光」；lumen 的更深来源不确定。英语 luminosity。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses begin with a star own power, then the total wattage, then what the eye perceives, the brightness of a colour, a standard sensitivity curve, a cosmological ruler, collider brightness and finally personal brilliance.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从恒星自身的本领开始，接着是总功率、人眼所感、颜色明度、标准敏感曲线、宇宙学尺子、对撞亮度，最后落在个人的光彩。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two stars equal to the eye, one of them pouring out far more energy.
core.cn: 核心意象：两颗星在眼中一样亮，其中一颗却放出多得多的能量。

branches.en: INTRINSIC POWER: the star own output, not the light that happens to reach an eye.
branches.cn: 固有功率：恒星自身的输出，而非恰好到达眼睛的光。

branches.en: WHAT IS SEEN: perceived brightness and colour lightness belong to the observer.
branches.cn: 所见：感知亮度与颜色明度属于观察者一侧。

branches.en: STANDARDS: a sensitivity curve and a distance ruler turn brightness into measurement.
branches.cn: 标准：敏感曲线与距离尺子把亮度变成测量。

branches.en: TECHNICAL ECHO: collider luminosity keeps only the idea of a denser, brighter beam.
branches.cn: 技术回声：对撞亮度只保留「更密即更亮」的观念。

branches.en: METAPHOR: mental or artistic light that draws admiration.
branches.cn: 比喻：引人赞赏的心智或艺术之光。

intro.en: Luminosity is an abstract noun from a Latin adjective, and the same root supplies the whole photometric vocabulary.
intro.cn: luminosity 是由拉丁形容词派生的抽象名词，同一词根提供了一整套光度学词汇。

latinIntro.en: Latin lumen, genitive luminis, gives luminosus and then luminositas; English adds -ity only in form, since the abstract noun already existed in Late Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 lumen（属格 luminis）给出 luminosus，再给出 luminositas；英语在形式上加了 -ity，而这个抽象名词在晚期拉丁中已经存在。

items.example: Lumen is the root of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: lumen 是整个词族的根。

items.example: The suffix turns light into full of light.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把「光」变成「充满光的」。

items.example: The dial is luminous at night.
items.exampleCN: 表盘在夜里发光。

items.example: The suffix makes an abstract noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀构成抽象名词。

items.meaning: the state of being full of light
items.example: The star luminosity is enormous.
items.exampleCN: 这颗恒星的光度极大。

items.example: The paint dried luminously white.
items.exampleCN: 这漆干后白得发亮。

items.meaning: light per unit area from a surface
items.meaningCN: 表面单位面积射出的光
items.example: The screen luminance was measured in nits.
items.exampleCN: 屏幕亮度以尼特计。

items.example: The firefly luminescence is chemical.
items.exampleCN: 萤火虫的发光是化学的。

items.example: A lamp illuminated the entrance.
items.exampleCN: 一盏灯照亮了入口。

latinEntries.meaning: light; the light of a lamp or eye

latinEntries.structure: luminosus, luminosa, luminosum (adj., first and second declension)
luminositas, luminositatis (f., third declension; Late Latin)

definition_zh: n. 争论，争执；主张，论点；竞争
definition_en: disagreement, a claim, or a chance of winning
core_image: 两个人同时按住同一份文件，各说各的理
scene: 律师们围绕一个条款吵得面红耳赤。 The lawyers were locked in contention over one clause.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：contention 指争论；句意是律师们围绕一个条款争执不下。

definition_zh: 综合；合成；综合体；合题
definition_en: the combining of separate parts into a whole, or the whole that results
core_image: 长桌上摊着十几张卡片，颜色相同的被归成一叠，最后连成一条完整的故事线
scene: 资料室的长桌上摊着十几张卡片，学生把颜色相同的归成一叠，再按线索连成一条完整的故事线。 Synthesis came only after the scattered notes were grouped and read as one account.
sceneCN: 这里 synthesis 指「把分散的部分合为一个整体」（第 1 个义项：综合）；句意为只有把散乱的笔记归类并读成一份完整叙述之后，综合才发生。

合成器；综合者（动词加表施动者或器具的后缀）

senses.title: Combining parts into a whole
senses.definition: the act of bringing separate elements together so that they form one coherent thing
senses.definitionCN: 把彼此分离的要素合到一起，形成一件连贯之物的行为
senses.example: Synthesis came only after the scattered notes were grouped and read as one account.
senses.exampleCN: 只有把散乱的笔记归类并读成一份完整叙述之后，综合才发生。
senses.why: The Greek noun means 'a putting together', and its verb means 'to place' — the image is literally placing side by side.
senses.whyCN: 希腊名词意为「放到一起」，其动词意为「放置」——画面就是字面上的并排摆放。

senses.title: Chemical synthesis
senses.definition: the building of a compound from simpler substances in a controlled reaction
senses.definitionCN: 在受控反应中由较简单物质构建化合物
senses.example: The synthesis of the dye takes four steps and a cold bath.
senses.exampleCN: 这种染料的合成需要四步和一个冰浴。
senses.why: Chemistry takes the literal meaning: separate substances are placed together and made to combine.
senses.whyCN: 化学取了字面义：分离的物质被放到一起并被迫结合。

senses.title: The composite result
senses.definition: the whole produced by combining, considered as a thing in its own right
senses.definitionCN: 由组合产生的整体，被当作独立存在之物
senses.example: The novel is a synthesis of two very different traditions.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说是两种极不相同传统的综合体。
senses.why: A verb of making yields a noun that can name what was made, not only the making.
senses.whyCN: 表「制作」的动词产出的名词，既能指制作，也能指所制之物。

senses.title: The Hegelian synthesis
senses.definition: in dialectical philosophy, the higher stage that reconciles a thesis and its opposite
senses.definitionCN: 在辩证哲学中，调和正题与其对立面的更高阶段
senses.example: The argument moves from thesis to antithesis to synthesis.
senses.exampleCN: 论证从正题走到反题，再走到合题。
senses.why: Philosophy borrowed the word for a resolution that keeps what was true in both earlier stages.
senses.whyCN: 哲学借这个词指一种保留前两阶段中真东西的解决。

senses.title: A synthesis essay
senses.definition: a piece of writing that combines several sources into one supported position
senses.definitionCN: 把若干来源合成一个有依据立场的写作
senses.example: The exam asks for a synthesis of three provided articles.
senses.exampleCN: 这场考试要求综合所提供的三篇文章。
senses.why: Writing instruction took the word for making a whole and applied it to an exercise that must weld sources together.
senses.whyCN: 写作教学把这个表示「造出整体」的词，用到一项必须把来源焊合起来的练习上。

senses.title: Speech synthesis
senses.definition: the artificial production of speech from text or symbols
senses.definitionCN: 由文字或符号人工生成语音
senses.example: Modern synthesis makes a recorded voice sound almost human.
senses.exampleCN: 现代语音合成让录制的声音听起来几乎像真人。
senses.why: Engineering extends the act to sound: separate phonemes are placed in order until a voice is built.
senses.whyCN: 工程把这动作扩展到声音上：分离的音素被按序放好，直到造出一个嗓音。

senses.title: Biological synthesis in cells
senses.definition: the building of a substance by a living cell from simpler materials
senses.definitionCN: 活细胞由较简单材料构建物质
senses.example: Protein synthesis begins at the ribosome.
senses.exampleCN: 蛋白质合成从核糖体开始。
senses.why: The cell performs the chemist's act at a smaller scale, and the word needs no change of form.
senses.whyCN: 细胞在更小的尺度上做化学家所做的事，而这个词无需改变形式。

senses.title: A level in a learning taxonomy
senses.titleCN: 综合层级（教育目标分类）
senses.definition: in education, the stage at which a learner builds something new from existing knowledge
senses.definitionCN: 在教育中，学习者用已有知识造出新东西的阶段
senses.example: The task sits at the synthesis level of the old taxonomy.
senses.exampleCN: 这项任务处在旧分类体系的综合层级。
senses.why: A curriculum made the act into a measurable stage, so a verb of building became a place on a ladder.
senses.whyCN: 一套课程把这个动作变成可测的阶段，于是表「构建」的动词成了阶梯上的一格。

intro.en: Synthesis is a Greek noun meaning 'a putting together', taken into English through Latin. Its parts are the same pieces that build thesis and hypothesis.
intro.cn: synthesis 是希腊名词，意为「放到一起」，经拉丁语进入英语。它的组成部分与构成 thesis 和 hypothesis 的是同样的碎片。

items.en: The verb meant 'to place, put, set'. It is the same placing verb that appears in thesis and in hypothesis.
items.cn: 这个动词意为「放置、摆、设立」。它就是出现在 thesis 与 hypothesis 里的那个「放置」动词。

items.en: The prefix meant 'together, with'. It appears in dozens of Greek compounds that English later borrowed.
items.cn: 这个前缀意为「一起、共同」。它出现在数十个后来被英语借入的希腊复合词中。

items.en: The noun meant 'a putting together, a composition'. It could name a compound object as well as the act of compounding.
items.cn: 这个名词意为「放到一起、组合」。它既能指被组合的物，也能指组合的行为。

items.en: Latin borrowed the noun with the same sense, and it also named a kind of composite garment; the borrowing is learned rather than native.
items.cn: 拉丁语以同样的意义借入这个名词，也用它指一种拼接式的衣服；这是书面借词，而非本族构词。

items.en: English used the word for logical composition first, and chemistry adopted it once the modern science took shape.
items.cn: 英语最初用它指逻辑上的组合，现代科学成形后化学采用了它。

items.en: Twentieth-century biology, computing and education each gave the word a fixed place. Source uncertain: the deeper origin of the placing verb is a reconstructed form.
items.cn: 20 世纪的生物学、计算与教育学各自给了这个词一个固定位置。来源不确定：那个「放置」动词的更早来源属重构形式。

note.en: The first group holds words built from the same Greek placing verb; the second holds near neighbours for combining.
note.cn: 第一组是由同一个希腊「放置」动词构成的词；第二组是表示「结合」的近义词。

entries.definition: Same placing verb without the 'together' prefix: a statement set down, hence a proposition or a long research essay.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个「放置」动词但不带「一起」前缀：被放下的陈述，因此指论点或长篇研究论文。

entries.definition: The prefix means 'under': something placed beneath as a basis, hence a provisional explanation.
entries.definitionCN: 前缀意为「在下」：作为基础被放在下面的东西，因此指暂定的解释。

entries.definition: The prefix means 'against': the counter-statement that a synthesis is said to reconcile.
entries.definitionCN: 前缀意为「相对」：那个据说被合题调和的反面陈述。

entries.definition: It describes what has been combined, or what is artificial; it never names the act of combining.
entries.definitionCN: 形容已被组合的东西，或人造之物；它从不指组合这一行为。

entries.definition: It says only that things are joined; it makes no claim that the result is coherent.
entries.definitionCN: 只说明事物被接在一起，不主张结果连贯。

entries.tag: parts made to work as one
entries.definition: It stresses that the joined parts function together, often of systems or groups.
entries.definitionCN: 强调接起来的各部分共同运作，常用于系统或群体。

entries.definition: It implies the parts lose their separate identity, which synthesis does not require.
entries.definitionCN: 暗示各部分失去独立身份，而 synthesis 不要求如此。

entries.definition: It names the resulting object as a thing with visible parts, not the process.
entries.definitionCN: 指结果之物，强调其各部分仍可见，而非指过程。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The Greek parts mean 'together' plus 'place': synthesis is placing things together.
normal.cn: 希腊成分意为「一起」加「放置」：synthesis 就是把东西放到一起。

normal.en: The family runs synthesis, synthesize, synthetic, synthesizer, synthetically.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 synthesis、synthesize、synthetic、synthesizer、synthetically。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the fields: chemical synthesis, protein synthesis, speech synthesis.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：化学合成、蛋白质合成、语音合成。

normal.en: The same placing verb gives thesis, hypothesis and antithesis with other prefixes.
normal.cn: 同一个「放置」动词配上别的前缀，给出 thesis、hypothesis、antithesis。

normal.en: The plural is Greek in shape, so the second syllable changes rather than gaining a simple ending.
normal.cn: 复数按希腊式变化，因此变的是第二个音节，而不是简单加一个词尾。

abstract.en: Picture two colours mixed until a third appears that neither contained.
abstract.cn: 想象两种颜色调出一种两者都不曾含有的第三种。

abstract.en: Picture a dozen cards sorted into piles, then read as one story.
abstract.cn: 想象十几张卡片分堆之后，被读成一个故事。

abstract.en: Picture a bridge built from two banks that never touch.
abstract.cn: 想象一座桥由两岸搭起，而两岸从不接触。

examples.en: The report is a synthesis of five separate studies.
examples.cn: 这份报告是五项独立研究的综合。

examples.en: The laboratory completed the synthesis in a single afternoon.
examples.cn: 实验室在一个下午就完成了这次合成。

examples.en: Good synthesis needs disagreement as much as agreement.
examples.cn: 好的综合既需要共识，也同样需要分歧。

dict_mnemonic.text: syn（一起）+ thesis（放置）＝ 把分开的东西放到一起 → 综合、合成。

root: 希腊 synthesis「放到一起、组合」，由 syn-「一起」+ tithenai「放置」构成；该动词更早来源属重构形式，一般认为与拉丁 facere「做」、英语 do 同出。经拉丁进入英语。同族有 thesis、hypothesis、antithesis、synthetic。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one placement: parts set side by side until they hold as one. The parts can be ideas, chemicals, traditions, philosophical opposites, sources in an essay, phonemes in a voice, molecules in a cell, or pieces of knowledge in a learner's task.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一次摆放展开：部分被并排放好，直到合为一体。这些部分可以是观念、化学品、传统、哲学上的对立面、文章里的来源、语音里的音素、细胞里的分子，或学习者任务中的知识碎片。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: many pieces laid side by side until they read as one object.
core.cn: 核心意象：许多碎片并排摆好，直到被读成一件东西。

chain: A WHOLE THAT DID NOT EXIST

branches.en: THE ACT AND THE MADE THING: placing together, and the composite that now stands on its own.
branches.cn: 行为与成品：放到一起的动作，以及如今独立站立的综合体。

branches.en: MADE IN A FLASK, MADE IN A CELL: the same building of a compound at two scales.
branches.cn: 在烧瓶里造，在细胞里造：同一件构建化合物的事，两个尺度。

branches.en: THE OPPOSITE KEPT: philosophy asks the whole to preserve what was true on both sides.
branches.cn: 被保留的对立面：哲学要求整体保住两边各自为真的部分。

branches.en: ONE VOICE FROM MANY PARTS: sources welded into an argument, phonemes welded into speech.
branches.cn: 多部分合成一个声音：来源焊成论证，音素焊成语音。

branches.en: A NAMED STEP: education turns the act into a level that can be assessed.
branches.cn: 被命名的一步：教育把这个动作变成一个可被评定的层级。

intro.en: Synthesis is a Greek compound taken whole, and its two parts also build several other English words.
intro.cn: synthesis 是整体借入的希腊复合词，它的两部分还构成若干其他英语词。

latinIntro.en: Latin passed the Greek noun on unchanged; the productive endings in English build the verb, the adjective and the device.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语原样传出这个希腊名词；英语里能产的词尾则造出动词、形容词与器具名。

items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把各部分聚到一处。

items.exampleCN: 这个分子可用两步合成。

senses.title: At or toward the front
senses.definition: situated at or near the front of the body or of an object, especially in anatomy
senses.definitionCN: 位于身体或物体的前部或近前部，尤用于解剖学
senses.example: The anterior surface of the heart faces the chest wall.
senses.exampleCN: 心脏的前面朝向胸壁。
senses.why: Latin ante 'before' plus the comparative ending -ior gives 'more forward', the front side of a body.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 ante「在前」加比较级词尾 -ior，意为「更靠前」，即身体的前侧。

senses.title: Earlier in time
senses.definition: coming before something else in time or in a sequence
senses.definitionCN: 在时间或顺序上先于另一事物
senses.example: Events anterior to the treaty are barely documented.
senses.exampleCN: 条约之前的事件几乎无文献记载。
senses.why: The same 'more forward' idea walks down the timeline: what is more forward on the road of time is earlier.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「更靠前」沿时间轴行走：在时间之路上更靠前的就是更早的。

senses.title: In linguistics, a front vowel sound
senses.definition: of a vowel produced with the tongue toward the front of the mouth
senses.definitionCN: 指发音时舌位靠前的元音
senses.example: The vowel in see is an anterior vowel.
senses.exampleCN: see 中的元音是前元音。
senses.why: Phonetics borrowed the anatomical front: the tongue's highest point sits forward in the mouth.
senses.whyCN: 语音学借用了「前部」这一解剖意象：舌的最高点位于口腔前部。

intro.en: Anterior is the Latin comparative of ante 'before': ante plus -ior, literally 'more before, more forward'.
intro.cn: anterior 是拉丁语 ante「在前」的比较级：ante 加 -ior，字面义为「更靠前」。

items.en: The root *h2ent- meant 'front, face', also giving English and Sanskrit words for face and forehead.
items.cn: 词根 *h2ent- 意为「前面、脸」，也生出英语与梵语中表示脸、额的词。

items.en: The preposition ante meant 'before, in front of', in space and in time.
items.cn: 介词 ante 意为「在前」，兼指空间与时间。

items.en: The comparative anterior meant 'former, more forward', used of times, positions, and ranks.
items.cn: 比较级 anterior 意为「在先的、更靠前的」，用于时间、位置与级别。

items.en: English borrowed it as a learned word, soon specialized in anatomy for the front of the body.
items.cn: 英语借入时为学术词，很快在解剖学中专指身体前侧。

items.en: Modern anatomy opposes anterior to posterior; general use for 'earlier' survives in formal writing.
items.cn: 现代解剖学以 anterior 对 posterior；「较早」的泛义保留在正式文字中。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the ante- comparative family and false cousins; the near-meaning group gathers front words.
note.cn: 形近组收 ante- 比较级词族与易混词；近义组收「前面」类词。

entries.definition: The rear-side opposite, built the same way on post- 'after'.
entries.definitionCN: 后侧的反义词，以同样方式由 post-「在后」构成。

entries.definition: An animal that eats ants; only the letters resemble, no relation.
entries.definitionCN: 食蚁兽。只是拼写相像，毫无词源关系。

entries.definition: A noun for what goes before; shares ante- but with the go-root cede.
entries.definitionCN: 指「在先之物」的名词；共享 ante-，词干为 cede「走」。

entries.definition: Of or at the front, used of surfaces and impacts.
entries.definitionCN: 义为「正面的；额的」，用于表面与撞击。

entries.definition: In human anatomy the belly side, which faces front.
entries.definitionCN: 人体解剖中指朝前的腹侧面。

entries.definition: A Germanic front word, as in foreleg and foretell.
entries.definitionCN: 日耳曼语的「前」，如 foreleg、foretell。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the comparative ending -ior, the anatomy pair, and the timeline reading.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用比较级词尾 -ior、解剖配对词，以及时间轴读法。

normal.en: ante + rior: more forward, so the front side.
normal.cn: ante 加 rior：更靠前，所以是前侧。

normal.en: Anterior versus posterior: front versus back, as in anatomy.
normal.cn: anterior 对 posterior：前对后，解剖学常用。

normal.en: In time, anterior means earlier than a given point.
normal.cn: 在时间上，anterior 指早于某一时点。

normal.en: Anterior teeth are the front ones you see in a smile.
normal.cn: 前牙就是微笑时看得见的那几颗。

normal.en: The ending -ior marks Latin comparatives, like prior and senior.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ior 是拉丁比较级标志，如 prior、senior。

abstract.en: Picture a person walking toward you, face first.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人迎面走来，脸在最前。

abstract.en: Picture an arrow labeled front pointing at a heart model.
abstract.cn: 想象一支写着「前」的箭头指向心脏模型。

abstract.en: Picture the earlier pages of a book pressed ahead of the rest.
abstract.cn: 想象书里较早的几页被压在最前面。

examples.en: The injury is on the anterior side of the knee.
examples.cn: 伤在膝盖前侧。

examples.en: Any period anterior to writing is prehistory.
examples.cn: 文字出现之前的任何时期都属史前。

examples.en: The anterior chamber of the eye was examined.
examples.cn: 眼前房被检查了一遍。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安踏体」——安踏鞋总在脚的前头带路，就是「前面的」

root: 拉丁语 anterior（ante「在前」的比较级，字面「更靠前」）→ 英语借词；解剖学中专指身体前侧，与 posterior 相对；亦表时间在先。

sensesIntro.en: One 'more forward' idea splits into front-of-body, earlier-in-time, and front-of-mouth phonetics.
sensesIntro.cn: 「更靠前」一个观念分出身体前侧、时间在先与口腔前部三个方向。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the side that faces forward, ahead of everything else
core.cn: 核心意象：朝向前方、领先于其余各面的一侧

branches.en: The anatomy line: anterior names the chest-and-face side.
branches.cn: 解剖线：anterior 指胸与脸的一侧。

branches.en: The timeline line: forward on the road of time is earlier.
branches.cn: 时间线：在时间之路上靠前即更早。

branches.en: The phonetics line: the tongue leans to the mouth's front.
branches.cn: 语音线：舌头偏向口腔前部。

branches.en: Space and time share one forward arrow.
branches.cn: 空间与时间共享同一支向前的箭头。

branches.en: The pair line: anterior exists against its twin posterior.
branches.cn: 配对线：anterior 与孪生词 posterior 相对而立。

intro.en: The word is ante- plus the Latin comparative -ior, with English endings added on top.
intro.cn: 这个词是 ante- 加拉丁比较级 -ior，再叠加英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entry shows ante itself, the base of the whole ante- family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示 ante 本身，即整个 ante- 词族的基础。

items.example: It supplies the 'front' in anterior.
items.exampleCN: 它为 anterior 提供「前」义。

items.example: It appears in prior, senior, posterior.
items.exampleCN: 见于 prior、senior、posterior。

items.example: It forms anteriorly.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 anteriorly。

items.example: It forms anteriority.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 anteriority。

items.example: It forms posterior, the rear word.
items.exampleCN: 它构成后侧词 posterior。

items.meaning: belly, front side of the body
items.example: It forms ventral, the anatomy cousin.
items.exampleCN: 它构成解剖近亲词 ventral。

items.example: It forms medial, the middle position.
items.exampleCN: 它构成中间位 medial。

items.example: Anti- resembles ante- but means against.
items.exampleCN: anti- 形近 ante- 但意为「反对」。

items.example: It shares the -ior comparative pattern.
items.exampleCN: 它与本词共享 -ior 比较级模式。

definition_zh: 对照组；实验或比较研究中不接受处理、用作比较基准的那一组；统计模型中的参照类别
definition_en: the group in an experiment or comparison study that receives no treatment and serves as a standard
core_image: 两只同样的托盘并排摆着，一只滴了药液，一只只滴清水，旁边一块牌子写着比较基准
scene: 实验室里两只同样的托盘并排摆着，一只滴了药液，另一只只滴清水，记录员每天比对两只托盘里的变化。 The control group received only plain water, so any change in the treated trays could be credited to the drug.
sceneCN: 这里指不接受处理、只作比较基准的那一组（第 1 个义项：实验里不接受处理、被用作比较标准的一组）；句意为对照组只拿到清水，因此处理组托盘里的任何变化都可归到药物上。图中可辨识物件：两只托盘、滴管、记录本、标签牌。

pos.zh: 对照组；比较基准组；参照组

senses.title: The group left untreated
senses.definition: the group in an experiment that receives no treatment and is used as the standard
senses.definitionCN: 实验里不接受处理、被用作比较标准的那一组
senses.example: The control group stayed on the old routine while the others tried the new one.
senses.exampleCN: 对照组沿用旧流程，其余各组试用新流程。
senses.why: Control first meant a check copy of an account, and this group is the check copy of an experiment.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指账目的核对副本，而这一组正是实验的核对副本。

senses.title: The placebo arm of a trial
senses.definition: the group in a clinical trial that receives a placebo or standard care instead of the tested drug
senses.definitionCN: 临床试验中接受安慰剂或标准治疗、而非受试药物的那一组
senses.example: Half the patients joined the control group and received a sugar pill.
senses.exampleCN: 一半病人进入对照组，服用了糖丸。
senses.why: A drug must be compared with something, and the placebo arm supplies that something.
senses.whyCN: 药物总要有个比较对象，安慰剂组就提供这个对象。

senses.title: The group without the variable
senses.titleCN: 未施加自变量的被试组
senses.definition: the participants in a psychology study who are kept out of the condition being tested
senses.definitionCN: 心理学研究中没有被放进所测条件的被试
senses.example: In the memory study, the control group watched the same film without any instruction.
senses.exampleCN: 在记忆研究中，对照组看了同一部影片，却没有收到任何指示。
senses.why: Psychology borrowed the design from medicine and kept the name for the group given no instruction.
senses.whyCN: 心理学借用了医学的设计，也沿用这个名字来指得不到指示的那一组。

senses.title: The ordinary class
senses.definition: the class in a teaching experiment that continues with the ordinary syllabus
senses.definitionCN: 教学实验中继续使用原有课程的班级
senses.example: The control group in the second school followed the ordinary syllabus.
senses.exampleCN: 第二所学校里的对照班沿用原有课程。
senses.why: Once a new method is tried in one class, the ordinary class becomes the measure of its effect.
senses.whyCN: 新教法在一个班试用后，照常上课的那个班就成了衡量效果的尺子。

senses.title: The comparison group in the field
senses.definition: a group followed in an observational study for comparison, without any assigned treatment
senses.definitionCN: 观察研究中被追踪、用于比较、并未被指派处理的一组
senses.example: A control group of untreated patients was followed for the same period.
senses.exampleCN: 一组未接受治疗的患者在同一时期被追踪。
senses.why: Even without random assignment, a comparable group keeps the comparison honest.
senses.whyCN: 即便没有随机分配，一个可比组也能让比较站得住。

senses.title: The batch left at room temperature
senses.definition: a batch of material or product kept under ordinary conditions to show what the treatment did
senses.definitionCN: 在普通条件下保存、用来检验处理效果的一批材料或产品
senses.example: A control group of uncoated panels was exposed on the same roof.
senses.exampleCN: 一组未涂层的板材被放在同一座屋顶上暴露。
senses.why: The laboratory extended the word from people to batches, because the logic of a baseline does not change.
senses.whyCN: 实验室把这个词从人扩展到批次，因为基准的逻辑并没有变。

senses.title: The reference category in a model
senses.titleCN: 统计模型中的参照类别
senses.definition: the category against which other categories are compared in a statistical model
senses.definitionCN: 统计模型中用来与其它类别比较的那个类别
senses.example: The untreated condition became the control group in the regression model.
senses.exampleCN: 未处理的条件在回归模型里成为参照组。
senses.why: In a model one category must stand still while the others move, and the old name suits that stillness.
senses.whyCN: 模型里总要有一个类别站着不动、其它类别相对它变动，旧名字正好适合这种不动。

senses.title: The untreated half of a matched pair
senses.titleCN: 配对研究里未受处理的一方
senses.definition: the member of a matched pair that is deliberately left without the supplement or treatment
senses.definitionCN: 配对研究中被有意不给补充剂或不给处理的那一方
senses.example: In the matched-pair study the control group was the twin who received no supplement.
senses.exampleCN: 在那项配对研究中，对照组就是没有服用补充剂的那位双胞胎。
senses.why: Pairing makes the comparison local: the untreated twin is the baseline for the treated one.
senses.whyCN: 配对把比较拉到近处：未受处理的双胞胎就是受处理那一位的基准。

senses.title: The yardstick in daily life
senses.definition: a person or standard against which someone measures ordinary life
senses.definitionCN: 日常生活中被人拿来衡量自己的对象或标准
senses.example: For a dieter, the control group is the friend who never counts calories.
senses.exampleCN: 对节食者来说，对照组就是那个从不计算热量的朋友。
senses.why: The experiment's baseline escaped the lab and became any steady point of comparison.
senses.whyCN: 实验的基准走出了实验室，成了任何稳定的比较点。

intro.en: Control is a bookkeeping word that became a laboratory word. Its first element is Medieval Latin contrarotulus, a counter-roll kept to check another roll, and group came through French from Italian. The phrase itself is a modern compound; its source chain is clear, while the exact year of its first written use is not known.
intro.cn: 前一词从记账语境走进实验室，前身是中世纪拉丁 contrarotulus，即用来核对另一本账的副本账；后一词经法语来自意大利语。这个短语本身是近现代复合词，词源链清楚，只是最早书面用例的年代不确定。

items.en: Contrarotulus joined contra- against and rotulus roll, naming a duplicate roll kept to check the accounts.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁的 contrarotulus 由意为「对着」的前缀与意为「卷册」的词根合成，指用来核对账目的副本账。

items.en: Contrerole carried the checking sense into English, and the early verb control meant to verify a record rather than to command.
items.cn: 古法语 contrerole 把这个核对义带进英语，早期动词义为核实记录，而不是发号施令。

items.en: By the seventeenth century control had widened from checking a record to regulating and commanding a course of events.
items.cn: 到十七世纪，这个词从核对记录扩展到调节与支配事态。

items.en: Groupe came from Italian gruppo cluster or knot, and English took it in the seventeenth century as a set of things or people.
items.cn: 法语 groupe 来自意大利语 gruppo「一团、一结」，英语在十七世纪把它借来表示一组事物或一群人。

items.en: Control group belongs to the vocabulary of controlled experiments, which took shape in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries; its first recorded use is date uncertain.
items.cn: 这个短语属于受控实验的词汇，这类方法在十九至二十世纪成形；其最早书面用例的年代不确定。

items.en: Twentieth-century statistics gave the same name to the reference category of a model, where no treatment is assigned at all.
items.cn: 二十世纪的统计学又把同一个名字给了模型的参照类别，那一类完全不被施加处理。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like control group; the second group names neighbouring ideas in experimental design.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「对照组」相近；第二组是实验设计里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: The verb and noun for checking, regulating or commanding; the phrase borrows its checking sense.
entries.definitionCN: 表示核对、调节或支配的动词与名词；短语借的是其中的核对义。

entries.definition: A person who controls, or a device that regulates a machine.
entries.definitionCN: 控制者，或调节机器的装置。

entries.definition: Kept under a rule or a comparison, as in a controlled experiment.
entries.definitionCN: 受规则或对照约束的，如受控实验。

entries.definition: A set of people or things placed together; the second half of the phrase.
entries.definitionCN: 放在一起的一群人或物；短语的后一半。

entries.definition: The act or result of putting things into groups.
entries.definitionCN: 把事物分组的行为或结果。

entries.definition: A broader name for any group used as a standard in a comparison.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指比较研究中用作标准的任何一组。

entries.definition: A group whose results are used as the point of reference.
entries.definitionCN: 其结果被用作参照的那一组。

entries.definition: The arm of a trial that receives an inactive treatment.
entries.definitionCN: 试验中接受无效处理的那一组。

entries.definition: The group measured before any change, giving the starting point.
entries.definitionCN: 在任何变动之前测量、提供起点的那一组。

entries.definition: The group that does receive the treatment, the partner of a control group.
entries.definitionCN: 接受处理的那一组，是对照组的搭档。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real bookkeeping source, the real compounds and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的记账来源、真实的复合方式与真实固定搭配。

normal.en: Control began as a counter-roll kept to check another roll, so a control group is the checking copy of an experiment.
normal.cn: control 最初是核对另一本账的副本账，所以对照组就是实验的核对副本。

normal.en: The phrase is simply control plus group: the group used for checking.
normal.cn: 这个短语就是「核对」加「组」：用来核对的那一组。

normal.en: Fixed phrases include untreated control group, matched control group and placebo control group.
normal.cn: 固定说法有未处理对照组、匹配对照组与安慰剂对照组。

normal.en: In a drug trial the control group often takes a sugar pill, so that the real drug must prove itself against it.
normal.cn: 药物试验里对照组常吃糖丸，真药得在它面前证明自己。

normal.en: Statistics reuses the name for the reference category of a model.
normal.cn: 统计学又把这个名字用在模型的参照类别上。

abstract.en: A control group is a mirror that shows what the treatment actually changed.
abstract.cn: 对照组是一面镜子，照出处理到底改变了什么。

abstract.en: It stands still on purpose, so that the other groups can show their movement.
abstract.cn: 它故意站着不动，好让别的组显出移动。

abstract.en: Without it, every change in the experiment belongs to nobody in particular.
abstract.cn: 没有它，实验里的每一种变化都说不清是谁造成的。

examples.en: The control group was chosen before the first dose was given.
examples.cn: 对照组在第一次给药之前就已选定。

examples.en: Without a control group, the improvement could have come from the season.
examples.cn: 若没有对照组，好转也可能只是季节带来的。

examples.en: The report compared the control group with two treated groups.
examples.cn: 报告把对照组与两个处理组作了比较。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「控住组」——把变量控住不动的那一组：对照组

root: 前一词源自中世纪拉丁 contrarotulus「对照账簿」，经古法语 contrerole 进入英语，由「核对」引申为「控制」；后一词源自法语 groupe，更早为意大利语 gruppo「一团、一结」。短语 control group 随十九至二十世纪的受控实验方法通行，词源清楚，最早书面用例的年代不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one baseline: the untreated group, the placebo arm, the psychology condition, the ordinary class, the field comparison, the batch left plain, the reference category, the members, and finally the yardstick of daily life.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项跟着同一条基准：不作处理的组、安慰剂组、心理学条件组、照常上课的班、实地比较组、常温放置的批次、统计参照类别、组内成员，最后是生活里的比较参照。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two identical trays side by side, one treated and one plain, so any difference can be traced to the treatment.
core.cn: 核心意象：两只同样的托盘并排摆着，一只处理过、一只原样，任何差别都能追到处理上。

branches.en: THE SET AND THE UNTREATED TWIN: the group as a whole, and the untreated member of a matched pair.
branches.cn: 整体与未处理的配对一方：作为一个整体的组，以及配对研究中被有意留作基准的那一方。

branches.en: THE TWO ARMS OF A TRIAL: the placebo arm in medicine and the no-instruction condition in psychology.
branches.cn: 试验的两臂：医学里的安慰剂组与心理学里的无指示条件。

branches.en: THE COMPARISON OUTSIDE THE LAB: an ordinary class and a field group followed without assignment.
branches.cn: 实验室外的比较：照常上课的班级与未被指派处理的实地群体。

branches.en: THE BATCH AND THE MODEL: material kept plain, and a category held still in a regression.
branches.cn: 批次与模型：保持原样的材料，以及在回归里保持不动的类别。

branches.en: THE EVERYDAY YARDSTICK: the baseline becomes any person or standard someone measures life against.
branches.cn: 日常的尺子：基准变成人们拿来衡量生活的任何对象或标准。

intro.en: The phrase joins a Latin bookkeeping word and a French loanword; the Latin list covers the control side, while group has no Latin ancestor.
intro.cn: 这个短语把拉丁记账词与法语借词合在一起；拉丁词条只覆盖 control 一侧，group 没有拉丁语祖先。

latinIntro.en: Latin contrarotulus and rotulus give the control half; group came from French groupe, itself from Italian gruppo.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 contrarotulus 与 rotulus 构成 control 一半；group 来自法语 groupe，更早为意大利语 gruppo。

items.example: The word began as a clerk's safeguard.
items.exampleCN: 这个词起初是账房的自保手段。

items.example: Accounts were kept on rolls before books.
items.exampleCN: 在册页之前，账目记在卷轴上。

items.example: The French form carried the checking sense across the Channel.
