definition_zh: 社会价值；某一事物对群体福祉与社会关系所具有的价值；也指社会共同认可的价值观
definition_en: the worth that something has for a community's wellbeing and relationships, or the values a society shares
core_image: 一条修好的村道通向学校，孩子们少走半小时，账本上却没有这笔收益，价值落在人身上而不落在钱包里
scene: 社区把废弃仓库改成公共厨房，志愿者计算它能给邻里带来多少好处。 The group measured the social value of turning the empty warehouse into a shared kitchen.
sceneCN: 这里 social value 指一项安排给社区带来的整体好处（第 1 个义项：对群体福祉的净益处）；句意为这个团体评估把空仓库改成公共厨房能带来多少社会价值。

pos.zh: 社会价值；社会效益（多作不可数，指对群体的整体好处）
社会价值观（用复数 social values，指一个社会共同认可的价值准则）

forms.label: 复数（指多种价值或价值准则）

derivatives.zh: 社会的；社交的（由拉丁 socius「同伴」加表示「属于」的后缀构成，转指属于同伴群体）
社会层面的（由 society 加表示「属于」的后缀构成，转指整个社会层面而非个人）
价值；重视（由拉丁 valere「强健、有价值」经古法语进入英语）
有价值的；贵重的（由 value 加表示「能……」的后缀构成，转指值得付出代价）
估价；估值（由 value 加表示「动作结果」的后缀构成，转指估定价值的过程或结果）
评估；评价（由表示「向外」的拉丁前缀加 value 的词根构成，转指把价值算出来）

senses.title: Net benefit to a community
senses.definition: the overall benefit that something brings to a community, including effects that no market price captures
senses.definitionCN: 某事物给一个共同体带来的整体好处，包括市场价格计不进去的效果
senses.example: The group measured the social value of turning the empty warehouse into a shared kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 这个团体评估把空仓库改成公共厨房能带来多少社会价值。
senses.why: The phrase takes the economic noun and widens its measure from buyers to a whole community.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语把经济名词的尺度从买家扩展到整个共同体。

senses.title: Shared moral values
senses.definition: the beliefs about right and good that a society holds in common, usually in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 一个社会共同持有的、关于对与善的信念，通常用复数
senses.example: Debates over taxation often turn into arguments about social values.
senses.exampleCN: 关于税收的争论常常变成关于社会价值观的争论。
senses.why: Here the word is not benefit but principle: what a society agrees to prize.
senses.whyCN: 这里谈的不是益处，而是原则：一个社会一致珍视什么。

senses.title: Social return on investment
senses.definition: the social and environmental return produced by an investment, often compared with its financial return
senses.definitionCN: 一项投资产生的社会与环境回报，常与财务回报并列计算
senses.example: The fund reports a social value of three pounds for every pound spent.
senses.exampleCN: 该基金报告每投入一英镑产生三英镑的社会价值。
senses.why: Accountants borrowed the word so that benefits to people could be put beside benefits to shareholders.
senses.whyCN: 会计行业借用这个词，使对人的益处能与对股东的益处并列。

senses.title: Symbolic value in consumption
senses.titleCN: 消费中的社会象征价值
senses.definition: the social meaning a good carries, such as status, belonging or taste, beyond its practical use
senses.definitionCN: 商品承载的社会含义，如地位、归属或品味，超出实用之外
senses.example: The brand's social value lay in the kind of crowd it let buyers join.
senses.exampleCN: 这个品牌的社会价值在于它让买家加入哪一类人群。
senses.why: Sociology of consumption added this sense: objects are bought for what they say about the buyer.
senses.whyCN: 消费社会学加入这一义项：人买东西，也为了它替买家说了什么。

senses.title: Value of social ties
senses.definition: the worth of relationships, trust and networks, often measured as social capital
senses.definitionCN: 关系、信任与网络所具有的价值，常以社会资本衡量
senses.example: Neighbours who watch each other's homes create social value that insurance cannot replace.
senses.exampleCN: 互相照看房屋的邻居创造了保险无法替代的社会价值。
senses.why: Relationships are a resource, so the phrase can name the worth stored in a network.
senses.whyCN: 关系本身就是资源，因此这个短语可以指储存在网络里的价值。

senses.title: Collective preference in economics
senses.definition: the value that a group assigns to a good, as distinct from the summed preferences of individuals
senses.definitionCN: 一个群体赋予某物的价值，区别于个体偏好的简单加总
senses.example: Welfare economics asks whether a policy increases social value overall.
senses.exampleCN: 福利经济学追问一项政策是否整体上增加了社会价值。
senses.why: Once choices are aggregated, the group's value need not equal any individual's value.
senses.whyCN: 一旦把选择加总，群体的价值就不必等于任何个人的价值。

senses.title: Social value in public policy
senses.titleCN: 公共政策中的社会价值
senses.definition: the social outcomes that public bodies require from procurement, funding or regulation
senses.definitionCN: 公共机构要求采购、资助或监管所产生的社会结果
senses.example: The council now scores bids partly on social value, such as local hiring.
senses.exampleCN: 市议会如今部分按社会价值给投标打分，例如本地用工。
senses.why: Policy turned the phrase into an award criterion, so it names outcomes a contract must deliver.
senses.whyCN: 政策把这个短语变成评标标准，于是它指合同必须交付的社会结果。

senses.title: Abstract: worth measured by effect on people
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：以对人的影响衡量的价值
senses.definition: any worth judged by how it affects people's lives rather than by what it sells for
senses.definitionCN: 任何以对人们生活的影响而非售价来判定的价值
senses.example: A library's social value shows in who feels welcome, not in its ticket sales.
senses.exampleCN: 图书馆的社会价值体现在谁觉得自己受欢迎，而不在门票收入。
senses.why: At its widest the phrase asks what a thing does for people, setting that against what it costs.
senses.whyCN: 推到最宽处，这个短语问的是一件事为人做了什么，再把它与代价对照。

intro.en: The phrase joins social, from Latin socius 'companion', to value, from Latin valere 'be worth'. It became a measure in economics and later in policy. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 这个短语把来自拉丁 socius「同伴」的 social 与来自拉丁 valere「有价值」的 value 接在一起。它先成为经济学的衡量词，后来进入政策语言。年代均为约数。

items.en: Socius meant 'companion, ally' and gives social, society and sociable through Latin socialis.
items.cn: socius 意为「同伴、盟友」，经拉丁 socialis 衍生 social、society 与 sociable。

items.en: Valere meant 'to be strong, be worth' and gives value, valid and valour.
items.cn: valere 意为「强健、有价值」，衍生 value、valid 与 valour。

items.en: Both nouns entered English through Old French: social in the sixteenth century, value in the fourteenth. The compound phrase is later than either word.
items.cn: 两个名词都经古法语进入英语：social 在十六世纪，value 在十四世纪。合成短语比这两个词都晚。

items.en: Nineteenth-century political economy used social value for worth judged by its effect on the community rather than by individual exchange.
items.cn: 十九世纪的政治经济学用 social value 指按对共同体的效果而非个人交换来判定的价值。

items.en: In the late twentieth century the phrase became a criterion in procurement, social investment and corporate reporting.
items.cn: 二十世纪后期，这个短语成为公共采购、社会投资与企业报告中的一项标准。

items.en: Source uncertain (first dates): the first printed use of the exact compound is not recorded, and the senses in economics and policy overlap in the record.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：这个确切合成短语最早印行于何时没有记录，经济学与政策中的两个义项在文献里彼此交叠。

note.en: Group one separates the compound from its plural moral sense and from neighbouring measures; group two holds broader ideas of public worth.
note.cn: 第一组把这个合成短语与它的复数道德义、以及邻近的衡量概念分开；第二组是更宽泛的公共价值概念。

entries.definition: The plural normally names the moral beliefs a society holds, not a measured benefit.
entries.definitionCN: 复数通常指一个社会持有的道德信念，而不是可衡量的益处。

entries.definition: A plainer phrase for how much a person or thing matters to others; it lacks the economic and policy edge.
entries.definitionCN: 更朴素的说法，指某人或某物对他人有多重要；它没有经济与政策的锋利边缘。

entries.definition: A management term for policies that profit the company and the community at once; it is a strategy label, not a general measure.
entries.definitionCN: 一个管理术语，指同时让公司与社区受益的政策；它是策略标签，不是一般衡量。

entries.definition: The trust and networks a community can draw on; it is one source of social value, not the value itself.
entries.definitionCN: 一个共同体可动用的信任与网络；它是社会价值的一个来源，而非价值本身。

entries.definition: The worth that public services create for citizens; it is the policy cousin of the phrase.
entries.definitionCN: 公共服务为公民创造的价值；它是这个短语在政策领域的近亲。

entries.definition: The change an action produces in people's lives; impact is the effect, social value is the judgement that the effect is good.
entries.definitionCN: 一个行动在人们生活中造成的变化；impact 是效果，social value 则是判定该效果为好。

entries.definition: What benefits everyone in a society; it is a moral ideal rather than a measurable return.
entries.definitionCN: 对一个社会中所有人都有益的东西；它是道德理想，而非可计算的回报。

entries.definition: The wellbeing of people, often measured by income, health and security; it is the outcome social value is claimed to raise.
entries.definitionCN: 人们的福祉，常以收入、健康与安全感衡量；它正是社会价值所声称要提升的结果。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real policy terms, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实的固定说法与真实的政策术语，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Social carries the companion root, so the phrase begins with what people share.
normal.cn: social 带着「同伴」词根，所以这个短语从人们共享的东西开始。

normal.en: Value carries the 'be worth' root, so the second half asks what the shared thing is worth.
normal.cn: value 带着「有价值」词根，所以后半段问这件共享之物值多少。

normal.en: Fixed phrases show the measure: create social value, measure social value, social value creation.
normal.cn: 固定说法显示衡量动作：创造社会价值、衡量社会价值、社会价值创造。

normal.en: The plural social values shifts to moral beliefs, while the singular usually stays with benefit.
normal.cn: 复数的 social values 转向道德信念，单数通常仍指益处。

normal.en: Policy uses the phrase as a scoring criterion, as in social value in procurement.
normal.cn: 政策把这个短语当作评分标准，如采购中的社会价值。

abstract.en: Picture a repaired footpath that saves children half an hour, though no ledger records the saving.
abstract.cn: 想象一条修好的小路让孩子省下半小时，而账本上不记这笔收益。

abstract.en: Picture a warehouse turned into a kitchen where neighbours cook and talk.
abstract.cn: 想象一座仓库变成厨房，邻居在里面做饭、说话。

abstract.en: Picture a price tag that leaves out the people who benefit.
abstract.cn: 想象一张价签，把受益的人全部漏掉。

examples.en: The charity reports the social value of its training programme in hours of work gained.
examples.cn: 这家慈善机构用获得的工时来报告其培训项目的社会价值。

examples.en: Residents argued that the new road had social value beyond its traffic figures.
examples.cn: 居民认为新路的价值不止交通数字，还有社会价值。

examples.en: The report set social value against the financial cost of the scheme.
examples.cn: 报告把该方案的社会价值与财务成本对照。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「搜秀 瓦尔优」——社会同伴共享的那份值得 → 社会价值

root: 拉丁 socius「同伴、盟友」+ 拉丁 valere「强健、有价值」；两个词干分别经古法语进入英语，合成短语晚于两者。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses keep one question, what a thing does for people, and ask it of community benefit, shared beliefs, investment return, status, relationships, collective choice, public contracts and finally any effect on lives.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项守住同一个问题——一件事为人做了什么——再依次问向社区益处、共享信念、投资回报、身份、关系、集体选择、公共合同，最后问向任何对人的生活影响。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a footpath that saves children half an hour sits beside a ledger that records no profit.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条让孩子省下半小时的小路，旁边是一本不记这项收益的账。

branches.en: MEASURED BENEFIT: community gain and its accounting cousin, social return on investment.
branches.cn: 可衡量的益处：社区所得，以及它在会计里的近亲——社会投资回报。

branches.en: SHARED BELIEFS AND AGGREGATED CHOICE: what a society prizes, and what a group's summed preference values.
branches.cn: 共享信念与加总选择：一个社会珍视什么，以及一个群体加总偏好后看重什么。

branches.en: SYMBOL AND NETWORK: goods carry standing, and relationships carry stored worth.
branches.cn: 符号与网络：商品承载身份，关系储存价值。

branches.en: CONTRACT CRITERION: policy turns the phrase into an outcome a bid must deliver.
branches.cn: 合同标准：政策把这个短语变成投标必须交付的结果。

branches.en: EFFECT ON LIVES: the widest reading asks only what a thing does for people.
branches.cn: 对人的生活影响：最宽的读法只问一件事为人做了什么。

intro.en: The phrase joins two Latin stems, one naming companions and one naming worth, each with its own English family.
intro.cn: 这个短语把两个拉丁词干接在一起，一个命名同伴，一个命名价值，各自带有一支英语词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin socius gives social, society and sociable; Latin valere gives value, valid, valour and evaluate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 socius 衍生 social、society 与 sociable；拉丁 valere 衍生 value、valid、valour 与 evaluate。

items.example: The first half names the group.
items.exampleCN: 前半段命名群体。

items.example: Socialis became English social.
items.exampleCN: socialis 成为英语 social。

items.structure: socius plus a suffix of body or state
items.example: Society is the group as a whole.
items.exampleCN: 社会就是作为整体的群体。

items.example: The second half names worth.
items.exampleCN: 后半段命名价值。

items.example: Value turned the verb into a noun.
items.exampleCN: value 把这个动词变成名词。

items.structure: value plus a suffix meaning 'able to be'
items.example: Valuable is value made an adjective.
items.exampleCN: valuable 是 value 的形容词化。

items.structure: value plus a suffix of action or result
items.example: Valuation names the measuring act.
items.exampleCN: valuation 命名衡量动作。

items.example: Societal lifts the view from persons to a society.
items.exampleCN: societal 把视角从个人抬到社会。

items.structure: an outward prefix plus the value root
items.example: Evaluate calculates social value.
items.exampleCN: evaluate 把社会价值算出来。

definition_zh: 地理的；地理学的；地理位置的；按地区划分的
definition_en: relating to geography, to the physical features and arrangement of places on the earth, or to the way things are distributed across regions
core_image: 一张摊开的等高线地图，河流与山脊被细线描出
scene: 这里指「地理的」。 In geographical terms the two towns are close, yet a mountain range separates them.
sceneCN: 这里 geographical 是「地理位置上」的（第 1 个义项：就空间位置而言）；句意：从地理上说这两座城镇很近，却有一道山脉把二者隔开。图中可辨识物件：等高线地图、山脉符号、河流、比例尺、指南针。

pos.zh: 地理的；地理学的；地理位置的；按地区划分的（多作定语）

collocations.zh: 地理标志（贸易与知识产权术语）

derivatives.zh: 地缘政治（共用 geo- 前缀）

senses.title: Of location on the earth
senses.titleCN: 地理位置的：就所处空间而言
senses.definition: relating to where a place sits on the earth's surface
senses.definitionCN: 关于某地在球面上所处位置的
senses.example: Their geographical position makes the harbour ice-free all winter.
senses.exampleCN: 它们的地理位置使这个港口整个冬天不结冰。
senses.why: geo- is Greek for 'earth' and -graphy means 'writing, description'; geographical therefore marks anything to do with describing the earth's places.
senses.whyCN: geo- 是希腊语“大地”，-graphy 意为“书写、描述”，因此 geographical 标记的是与描述大地各处有关的事物。

senses.title: Of geography as a science
senses.titleCN: 地理学的：作为一门学科
senses.definition: belonging to the academic study of the earth's surface, climate and human use of it
senses.definitionCN: 属于研究地表、气候及人类利用方式的学科
senses.example: The journal publishes geographical research on migration.
senses.exampleCN: 该刊发表关于人口迁移的地理学研究。
senses.why: Once geography became a university discipline in the 19th century, the adjective also named its methods, journals and departments.
senses.whyCN: 地理学在 19 世纪成为大学学科之后，这个形容词也用来指称其方法、刊物与院系。

senses.title: Of terrain and landforms
senses.titleCN: 地形地貌的：山川起伏本身
senses.definition: relating to the physical shape of the land, such as mountains, valleys and coasts
senses.definitionCN: 关于山地、谷地、海岸等自然地表形态的
senses.example: Geographical features such as ridges decide where roads can run.
senses.exampleCN: 山脊这样的地形特征决定了道路可以往哪里修。
senses.why: The earliest geography described the visible face of the earth; the adjective still points to relief and drainage rather than to people.
senses.whyCN: 最早的地理学描述的是大地可见的表面；这个形容词至今仍可指起伏与水系，而非人群。

senses.title: Divided by region
senses.titleCN: 按地区划分的：以区域为单位
senses.definition: organized or counted separately for each region
senses.definitionCN: 按区域分别组织或统计的
senses.example: Sales are reported on a geographical basis, not by product line.
senses.exampleCN: 销售额按地区而非按产品线报告。
senses.why: Because geography partitions the world into regions, the adjective came to describe any arrangement that follows regional boundaries.
senses.whyCN: 由于地理学把世界划分为区域，这个形容词便用来描述任何沿区域边界作出的安排。

senses.title: Of spatial distribution
senses.titleCN: 空间分布的：物种或现象铺开的样子
senses.definition: relating to how something is spread across space
senses.definitionCN: 关于某物在空间上如何铺展开的
senses.example: The geographical distribution of the beetle stops at the frost line.
senses.exampleCN: 这种甲虫的地理分布止于霜冻线。
senses.why: Distribution needs a map: the adjective ties a pattern of occurrence to the places where it holds.
senses.whyCN: 分布需要一张地图：这个形容词把出现规律与发生地点绑定起来。

senses.title: Of a place's physical setting
senses.titleCN: 地理环境的：某地的自然条件
senses.definition: relating to the natural conditions of a particular place, such as climate, soil and water
senses.definitionCN: 关于某地气候、土壤、水源等自然条件的
senses.example: Geographical conditions limit how much rice the valley can produce.
senses.exampleCN: 地理环境条件限制了这条谷地能产多少稻米。
senses.why: Place-based description shifts from 'where it is' to 'what it is like there', which is the environmental reading of the same word.
senses.whyCN: 以地点为基础的描述从“它在哪”转向“那里条件如何”，这就是同一个词的环境义读法。

senses.title: Of a trade origin label
senses.titleCN: 地理标志的：产地名称的法律保护
senses.definition: in trade law, naming a product whose reputation is tied to a specific place
senses.definitionCN: 贸易法中指产品声誉与特定产地绑定的名称保护
senses.example: Champagne is protected as a geographical indication in many markets.
senses.exampleCN: 香槟在许多市场作为地理标志受到保护。
senses.why: If a product's quality comes from its region, the region's name becomes the legal asset; the adjective marks that kind of protected name.
senses.whyCN: 当产品品质源自其地区时，地区名本身就成了法律资产；这个形容词标记的正是这类受保护的名称。

senses.title: Of maps and coordinates
senses.titleCN: 地图与坐标的：测绘所用的
senses.definition: relating to mapping, survey grids and coordinates
senses.definitionCN: 关于地图绘制、测量网格与坐标的
senses.example: Every site is recorded with its geographical coordinates.
senses.exampleCN: 每个地点都用其地理坐标记录。
senses.why: Description of the earth requires a grid; the adjective extends from the described surface to the instruments that describe it.
senses.whyCN: 描述大地需要一套网格；这个形容词从被描述的表面延伸到用于描述它的工具。

intro.en: Geographical joins Greek geo- 'earth' and -graphical 'relating to writing or drawing', through the ancient compound geographia 'description of the earth'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: geographical 由希腊 geo-“大地”与 -graphical“与书写、描绘有关的”组合而成，中间经过古代复合词 geographia“对大地的描述”。年代为约数。

items.en: Greek gē meant 'earth, land', and graphein meant 'to write, scratch, draw'. Joined as geōgraphia, the compound meant 'a writing about the earth'. The coinage is generally attributed to Eratosthenes in the 3rd century BC.
items.cn: 希腊 gē 意为“大地、陆地”，graphein 意为“书写、刻画、描绘”。合为 geōgraphia，意为“关于大地的记述”。该复合词的创制一般认为是公元前 3 世纪的埃拉托色尼。

items.en: Latin took the word as geographia, and French formed géographie. English geography appears in the 16th century alongside the older borrowings of the same Greek stems.
items.cn: 拉丁语借作 geographia，法语构成 géographie。英语 geography 于 16 世纪出现，与同一希腊词干的更早借词并行。

items.en: The ending -ical comes from Latin -icalis, itself from Greek -ikos, the suffix that makes 'relating to' adjectives. Latin geographicus and Greek geōgraphikos both existed.
items.cn: 后缀 -ical 来自拉丁 -icalis，后者又出自希腊 -ikos，即构成“与……有关”形容词的后缀。拉丁 geographicus 与希腊 geōgraphikos 均已存在。

items.en: Geographical enters English in the 16th century as the adjective of the new discipline, competing with geographic ever since.
items.cn: geographical 于 16 世纪进入英语，作为这门新学科的形容词，此后一直与 geographic 并存竞争。

items.en: The 20th century added geographical indication in trade law and geographical information systems in computing, both extending 'about places' into new fields.
items.cn: 20 世纪新增了贸易法中的地理标志与计算领域的地理信息系统，都把“关于地点”延伸到新领域。

items.en: The date of Eratosthenes' coinage is reported by later writers rather than by a surviving title page, and the deeper origin of graphein is disputed; it is often linked to a root meaning 'to scratch'.
items.cn: 埃拉托色尼创制此词的年代来自后世记述，而非存世的书名页；graphein 的更深来源有争议，常被联系到一个意为“刻划”的词根。

note.en: The first group contains close spelling relatives from the same roots; the second contains words about space and place that do not share the earth-description core.
note.cn: 第一组是同根形近词；第二组是谈空间与地点、但不含“描述大地”这一核心的词。

entries.definition: The shorter adjective of geography, preferred in North American usage before nouns. It differs from geographical in style, not in sense.
entries.definitionCN: geography 的较短形容词，北美用法中更常置于名词前；与 geographical 的差别在风格而非词义。

entries.definition: An adverb about rock structure and deep time, from -logy 'study', not from -graphy 'description'. It answers 'how old and how formed', not 'where'.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，谈岩层构造与漫长年代，来自 -logy“研究”而非 -graphy“描述”；它回答“多古老、怎么形成”，而非“在哪里”。

entries.definition: Relating to shape and measurement, from metron 'measure'. It shares geo- with geographical but has nothing to do with places.
entries.definitionCN: 关于形状与度量，来自 metron“测量”；与 geographical 共用 geo-，但与地点无关。

entries.definition: Relating to space and position in any frame, including rooms and graphs; it does not require the earth's surface.
entries.definitionCN: 关于任何框架中的空间与位置，包括房间和图表；不要求涉及地表。

entries.definition: Relating to territory held by a state or animal; it adds ownership or defence, which geographical does not.
entries.definitionCN: 关于国家或动物所占的领地；带有归属或防卫含义，而 geographical 没有。

entries.definition: Relating to a region within a country; it names an administrative scale rather than a physical setting.
entries.definitionCN: 关于国内某一区域；标明的是一种行政尺度，而非自然条件。

entries.definition: Relating specifically to the detailed relief of a surface, from topos 'place' and graphein 'write'; narrower than geographical.
entries.definitionCN: 专指地表起伏细节，来自 topos“地点”与 graphein“书写”；比 geographical 更窄。

entries.definition: In geography, 'physical' contrasts natural features with human ones; the pair physical geography and human geography marks that split.
entries.definitionCN: 在地理学中，“自然的”与“人文的”相对；自然地理与人文地理这一对术语正体现该分工。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词。

normal.en: geo- 'earth' + graph- 'write' + -ical: a written description of the earth.
normal.cn: geo-“大地”+ graph-“书写”+ -ical：对大地所作的书面描述。

normal.en: geography is the noun, geographer the person, geographic and geographical the adjectives, geographically the adverb.
normal.cn: geography 是名词，geographer 指人，geographic 与 geographical 是形容词，geographically 是副词。

normal.en: The phrase geographical distribution is the standard label for range maps.
normal.cn: 地理分布是分布图的标准说法。

normal.en: geographical indication is a legal term, not a synonym for location.
normal.cn: 地理标志是法律术语，不是“位置”的同义词。

normal.en: geology, geometry and geography all begin with geo-, but their second elements mean study, measure and write.
normal.cn: geology、geometry、geography 都以 geo- 开头，但第二部分分别是研究、测量、书写。

abstract.en: Picture a folded map spread on a table, its contour lines tightening as the hills rise.
abstract.cn: 想象一张摊在桌上的折叠地图，山越高，等高线越密。

abstract.en: Picture a dotted range map where the dots stop exactly at a cold coastline.
abstract.cn: 想象一张打点分布图，点阵恰好在寒冷的海岸线处停止。

abstract.en: Picture a wine bottle whose label carries a place name protected by law.
abstract.cn: 想象一只酒瓶，标签上印着受法律保护的产地名。

examples.en: Geographical barriers kept the two languages apart for centuries.
examples.cn: 地理屏障使这两种语言分隔了数个世纪。

examples.en: The team compared the geographical spread of the disease across three provinces.
examples.cn: 研究组比较了该疾病在三个省份的地理分布。

examples.en: Under the agreement, the name can no longer be used as a geographical indication by other producers.
examples.cn: 根据该协议，其他生产者不得再将该名称作为地理标志使用。

dict_mnemonic.text: “记（geo）一下地图（graph）” → geographical 地理的、按地区划分的

root: 希腊 gē“大地”+ graphein“书写、描绘”→ geōgraphia“对大地的记述”；拉丁 geographia、法语 géographie → 英语 geography + -ical。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all return to one act: writing down what the earth looks like, and then sorting the world by the places so described.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都回到同一个动作：把大地的样子书写下来，再按这样描述出的地点来划分世界。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a contour map in which every line writes down the shape of the land.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张等高线地图，每条线都在书写大地的形状。

branches.en: PLACE AND DISCIPLINE: the adjective serves both the position of a town and the academic study of places.
branches.cn: 位置与学科：这个形容词既服务于一城的位置，也服务于关于地点的学术研究。

branches.en: PHYSICAL SETTING: landforms and local climate are the visible and environmental faces of the same description.
branches.cn: 自然条件：地形与地方气候是同一描述的外观面与环境面。

branches.en: SORTING SPACE: reporting by region and mapping a range both slice the world along lines drawn on a map.
branches.cn: 切分空间：按地区报告与绘制分布范围，都沿地图上画出的线切开世界。

branches.en: LEGAL PLACE: a product tied to a region turns a place name into protected property.
branches.cn: 法律上的地点：与地区绑定的产品把地名变成受保护的财产。

branches.en: THE GRID: coordinates are description made numerical, so the map can be read by machines.
branches.cn: 网格：坐标是数值化的描述，使地图可被机器读取。

intro.en: Geographical is a three-part build: the Greek prefix geo-, the Greek stem graph-, and the adjective ending -ical. All three are still productive in English.
intro.cn: geographical 由三部分构成：希腊前缀 geo-、希腊词干 graph-、形容词词尾 -ical。三者在英语中仍有构词能力。

latinIntro.en: The same Greek stems travel through Latin borrowings into dozens of English words: geography, geology, geometry, graph, paragraph, photograph, biography and telegraph.
latinIntro.cn: 同一批希腊词干经拉丁借词进入大量英语词：geography、geology、geometry、graph、paragraph、photograph、biography、telegraph。

items.meaning: relating to the description of places on earth
items.meaningCN: 与描述大地各处有关的
items.example: The atlas groups the plates by geographical region.
items.exampleCN: 这本地图集按地理区域编排图版。

items.meaning: the study or description of the earth's surface
items.example: She teaches geography to secondary students.
items.exampleCN: 她给中学生教地理。

items.example: The geographer mapped every village along the river.
items.exampleCN: 这位地理学家把河边的每个村庄都绘入地图。

items.example: The report includes a geographic breakdown of sales.
items.exampleCN: 报告包含按地理划分的销售数据。

items.meaning: in terms of rock structure and deep time
items.meaningCN: 从地质构造与深远年代的角度
items.example: Geologically, the valley is very young.
items.exampleCN: 从地质上看，这条谷地非常年轻。

items.meaning: measurement of the earth, now the study of shape
items.meaningCN: 原为土地测量，今指几何学
items.example: The bridge design depends on plain geometry.
items.exampleCN: 这座桥的设计依赖基础几何。

items.meaning: a drawing that shows how values relate
items.meaningCN: 用图线表示数值关系的图表
items.example: The graph shows rainfall against temperature.
items.exampleCN: 这张图显示降雨量与温度的关系。

items.meaning: treating the earth as the centre
items.example: The geocentric model held sway for centuries.
items.exampleCN: 地心模型统治了数百年。

latinEntries.meaning: geography, a written account of lands
latinEntries.meaningCN: 地理；关于各地的书面记述

latinEntries.meaning: relating to, having the nature of
